notes.title: American Truck Simulator: 1.56 Update Release
notes.notes:
[p]We have good news for all American truckers. The 1.56 Update for [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/"]American Truck Simulator[/url] is officially released! Let's see what's in store for you.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/1032f3e48e86a7bc29936cf08b0435a6237b0f5d.jpg"][/img]Before we take you through all the new features this update brings to the game, we would like to thank everyone who took part in the Open Beta and reported issues on our forum. This really helped us fine-tune the update and make it ready for the full update release.[/p][previewyoutube="qC1tlVsf0so;full"][/previewyoutube][p][b]Height Blend[/b][/p][p]The Height Blend effect is a technique used to create more realistic and visually appealing transitions between different types of terrains or surfaces, like grass, dirt, or stone. It works by utilizing a height map texture, a grayscale image that represents the elevation of a surface, to determine how different textures blend together.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/d7a802e778df09748096f7d3bfe04b7f12101638.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/c859d11b3a5afec7e1a2a910ab122cf731b1253c.jpg"][/img][/p][p]For example, where a grassy hill slopes into a rocky cliff, the height blend effect ensures the textures mix naturally based on the terrain's height and slope, avoiding harsh or unnatural edges. For map designers, it eliminates the need for many decals, which previously had to be added to achieve a believable look, saving time and effort.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/6ec0ec7e735d155fc7089e0428246a5afc39b33d.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/1b43f7f752881d2b027574be1645480e7cd64f28.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Under the hood, our team has converted, tweaked, and visually checked over 1,300 materials from our library to ensure seamless integration. During our testing, we didn't observe any significant impact on performance. There is only a minimal increase in memory usage, caused by the newly added texture.

[b]Dynamic Cargo Improvements[/b][/p][p]We have expanded the dynamic loading and unloading feature to cover more cargo types. Truckers using their own logger or chipvan trailers can now see a material handler dynamically managing their loads at selected depots across the USA. The logger's cargoes - large tubes, logs, and utility poles - as well as the chipvan's metal scrap, are now included in this feature to make your trucking experience more immersive.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/5b96f3746ec5e4d7fa178f4949d0d316d2920517.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/d27ad243eb68755c5d0c8e1b96b891438bb91f89.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/75ab1cae4341d4d9f81061b03720d04e8d55b2e8.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Camera Zoom - Hold/Toggle[/b][/p][p]The 1.56 update also brings a small but welcomed accessibility feature. Players can now choose whether the interior zoom function requires holding the key (the default) or can be switched to a toggle mode. This option not only adds convenience but also improves accessibility, offering a more comfortable way for all players to take a closer look at the details inside their cab, in the mirrors, and around their truck. Players can find this feature in "Options → Gameplay and Options → Accessibility".[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/7c16f63463d9f7aec5b5f0061b6a32a5c803ec12.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]DLC Browser[/b][/p][p]We are also introducing a brand-new design for the DLC Browser. This redesign aims to make browsing and discovering additional content for your game easier and more enjoyable.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/f28d3e5caa5dde4fad9f8f3cc32fe10cd3d713b7.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/6414566e98a5097226558c1f124be4288c236ee6.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The updated browser now features improved categorization, with clear sections such as Featured, Bundles, Map, Cargo, Trailer, Accessories, and Paint Jobs. The main layout has been completely redesigned, increasing the number of items displayed per row from three to four for a cleaner and more modern look.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/8d4fb7f4ca8e3a6aa42955c32d48456c65913d1c.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/9c945144ee17c65f16b2e2dd26654da9d4b2969b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The DLC browser is just the beginning of a feature with the potential to grow and evolve further. While it may take time and further development to see how far it can go, the vision is to make it possible for players to explore and enjoy all our DLCs without ever leaving the game. We plan to continue gathering feedback, and this feature might get some future adjustments.[/p][p][b]Career Creation and Start-up Flow[/b][/p][p]We gave the career system a big refresh, which includes a new UI design and improved navigation. The old table-style list of careers has been replaced with larger, card-like slots that give a cleaner and more modern look. Your active career will always appear at the top, with your other careers sorted by most recent playtime. The first slot is reserved for starting a brand-new career, and switching between your careers is now quicker; simply double-click on a card to jump right in.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/7f044293e2db45e968a85aeeaf8181ce10e8e394.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/e52ec438b9b7a6ffd45c440d70e3ecc729494c7b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Whether you're a new player or a seasoned veteran, the career creation process has also been redesigned to be simpler and clearer, focusing only on the most important options and selections needed when starting a new career.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/0e7ef310a3df85e6f7cc5c2977914d72749fa8fd.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/5b513827ecab4f7436e9e8e86072fb29334759e5.jpg"][/img][/p][p]A new Truck Preference screen has also been added between selecting your headquarters and the opening cutscene. Here, you can preview all available trucks in a rotating 3D view that spins automatically, or you can rotate them yourself. You'll be able to cycle through brands, switch between different models, or even press a “random” button to let the game surprise you. We hope this new preference screen gives both new and experienced players a detailed look at each truck and its key specifications.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/68b47191aebcabc8e8950cfdaf42df9b10e6d091.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/b251c657ab9ae84fac9f3a15f3b627e22360e201.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We've also refreshed the Edit Career screen, which now focuses only on details that really matter for your career. Many of the older fields have been moved elsewhere, keeping the editing process simple and uncluttered. To make things more convenient, clicking on your career from the desktop top bar now opens a new Driver Details screen, where you can view all the important info about your career and even change your avatar without having to return to the title screen.[/p][p]This redesigned approach not only makes career navigation smoother but also gives the whole experience a cleaner, more modern feel. Whether you're starting your very first trucking journey or managing multiple careers, we hope this update makes your career management more streamlined and accessible. As we gather more input, this feature could see further improvements down the road.[/p][p][b]Management UI/UX Improvements[/b][/p][p]In the Company tab on the Desktop, the Driver, Trailer, Truck, and Garage Manager screens now feature a redesigned company subscreen. The refreshed company subscreen shows the company name and logo alongside key statistics, a redesigned seven-day profit graph, and highlights of the most profitable assets. It also introduces an economy summary pop-up for quick performance review and a company properties option for editing the name and logo. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/f30d5da03be42a8a63790941697113788b42313a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We've also added a quality-of-life improvement to the relocation screen: when both a driver and their truck can be placed in the same garage slot, a checkbox allows relocating them together in one step. To improve accessibility, the Garage Manager and Driver Manager are now unlocked from the very start of the game, rather than only after purchasing a truck. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/e0061ae10afe35e5ee11416565cde6586b3f7733.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Finally, the Driver Manager subscreen has been polished with a clearer layout, including a new XP bar that lets players track their NPC drivers' progress, and a simplified job information and skills overview, where you can assign a collective preferred training policy for newly hired drivers. Our plan is to keep gathering feedback, so in the future, this feature might be further refined.  [/p][p][b]Changelog[/b][/p][p][b]Gameplay[/b]  [/p][list][*][p]Dynamic cargo improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Camera zoom - hold/toggle[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Visual[/b]  [/p][list][*][p]Height blend[/p][/*][/list][p][b]UI[/b][/p][list][*][p]Career creation – redesigned UI/UX and start-up flow[/p][/*][*][p]Management UI/UX improvements[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Other[/b]  [/p][list][*][p]DLC browser - redesigned[/p][/*][/list][p]Make sure to stay tuned for more updates from American Truck Simulator by following us on [url="https://twitter.com/SCSsoftware"]X/Twitter[/url], [url="https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/"]Instagram[/url], [url="https://www.facebook.com/scssoft"]Facebook[/url], [url="https://bsky.app/profile/scssoft.com"]Bluesky[/url], and [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@scssoftware"]TikTok[/url], or by [url="https://www.scssoft.com/newsletter"]subscribing to our newsletter[/url]! Until then, we wish you safe travels![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: American Truck Simulator: 1.56 Update Open Beta
notes.notes:
[p]Today, we are happy to share that the 1.56 Open Beta branch for [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/"]American Truck Simulator[/url] is now available to try and test out. If you plan on participating in this Open Beta, we would truly appreciate it if you could help us by reporting any bugs you may encounter in the [url="https://forum.scssoft.com/viewforum.php?f=340"]appropriate section(s) of our official forums[/url]. Your feedback and reports really aid our team, and we would like to thank you in advance for taking the time to help us out. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/118e0bf608528afff653df0f7f067c77f9291ed9.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Alongside this, we'd also like to mention that our teams are currently adapting to a new internal update cycle. Because future console releases will require us to lock in content earlier, this adjustment helps us better coordinate timing across every platform. It's a step toward greater consistency, and we're confident it will keep things running like clockwork.  [/p][p]It's also worth noting that while today's blog highlights some of the most visible changes and new content, there is always a lot happening behind the scenes. From preparing for consoles to laying the groundwork for upcoming projects such as the Coaches expansion for ETS2 or the Road Trip project for ATS, our teams are working hard to build the future of our games.  [/p][p]Now, without further ado, let's take a look at what the 1.56 Open Beta has in store.  [/p][p][b]Height Blend[/b]  [/p][p]Height blend effect is a technique used to create more realistic and visually appealing transitions between different types of terrains or surfaces, like grass, dirt, or stone. It works by utilizing a height map texture, a grayscale image that represents the elevation of a surface, to determine how different textures blend together. For map designers, it eliminates the need for many decals, which previously had to be added to achieve a believable look, saving time and effort. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/756352d3ca8a19b5ae2fc1484ca6963121cbf62d.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/e99410f507e02009351725043d6b86e387cbdccc.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Under the hood, our team has converted, tweaked, and visually checked over 1,300 materials from our library to ensure seamless integration.[/p][p][b]Dynamic Cargo Improvements[/b][/p][p]We are expanding the dynamic loading and unloading feature to cover more cargo types. Truckers using their own logger or chipvan trailers will now see a material handler dynamically managing their loads at selected depots across the USA. The logger's cargoes - large tubes, logs, and utility poles - as well as the chipvan's metal scrap, are now included in this feature to make your trucking experience more immersive. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/2f89fd63aae84b5f434bc9a816607449a6d68828.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/dacc79cf5f5dda1daaabfd2344ccc929d6c56c7e.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/9d3da1ce8a6dbb097d48aec8d2bbf3b2cb688671.jpg"][/img][/p][p]
[b]Camera Zoom - Hold/Toggle[/b]

The 1.56 update also brings a small but welcome accessibility feature. Players can now choose whether the interior zoom function requires holding the key (the default) or can be switched to a toggle mode. This option not only adds convenience but also improves accessibility, offering a more comfortable way for all players to take a closer look at the details inside their cab, in the mirrors, and around their truck. Players can find this feature in "Options → Gameplay and Options → Accessibility". [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/b941dce0f7e28723944af9a64f53d45db0dcfce6.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]DLC Browser[/b]  [/p][p]With the 1.56 update, we are also introducing a brand-new design for the DLC Browser. This redesign aims to make browsing and discovering additional content for your game easier and more enjoyable, while also giving you a better overview of what each DLC has to offer.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/44c9d541744ad9c98b40f4f26cc86d39c0d56956.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/9bfd05cac740d2f6c0eac4e7da3063db607e065f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The updated browser now features improved categorization, with clear sections such as Featured, Bundles, Map, Cargo, Trailer, Accessories, and Paint Jobs. The main layout has also been refreshed, increasing the number of items displayed per row from three to four for a cleaner and more modern look. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/c58053dc313e8dfecb6f64a100da11ccd6cbb633.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/adee17a9b8a5008808270fc3a231d67e75746507.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The DLC browser is just the beginning of a feature with the potential to grow and evolve further. While it may take time and development to see how far it can go, the vision is to make it possible for players to explore and enjoy all of our DLC without ever leaving the game. Please keep in mind that this feature is still deep in the work-in-progress stage.  [/p][p][b]New Profile Creation and Start-up Flow[/b]  [/p][p]We're giving the profile system in Euro Truck Simulator 2 and American Truck Simulator a big refresh, which includes a new UI design and improved navigation. The old table-style list of profiles has been replaced with larger, card-like slots that give a cleaner and more modern look. Here, you can preview all available trucks in a rotating 3D view that spins automatically, or rotate them yourself. You'll be able to cycle through brands, switch between different models, or even press a “random” button to let the game surprise you. We hope this new preference screen gives both new and experienced players a detailed look at each truck and its key specifications.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/68b47191aebcabc8e8950cfdaf42df9b10e6d091.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/b251c657ab9ae84fac9f3a15f3b627e22360e201.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We've also refreshed the Edit Profile screen, which now focuses only on details that really matter for your career. Many of the older fields have been moved elsewhere, keeping the editing process simple and uncluttered. To make things more convenient, clicking on your profile from the desktop top bar now opens a new Driver Details screen, where you can view all the important info about your career and even change your avatar without having to return to the title screen.  [/p][p]This redesigned approach not only makes profile navigation smoother but also gives the whole experience a cleaner, more modern feel. Whether you're starting your very first trucking journey or managing multiple careers, we hope this update makes your profile management more streamlined and accessible. Please note that this feature is still very much a work in progress.  [/p][p][b]Management UI/UX Improvements[/b]  [/p][p]In the Company tab on the Desktop, the Driver, Trailer, Truck, and Garage Manager screens now feature a redesigned company subscreen. The refreshed company subscreen shows the company name and logo alongside key statistics, a redesigned seven-day profit graph, and highlights of the most profitable assets. It also introduces an economy summary pop-up for quick performance review and a company properties option for editing the name and logo.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/f30d5da03be42a8a63790941697113788b42313a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We've also added a quality-of-life improvement to the relocation screen: when both a driver and their truck can be placed in the same garage slot, a checkbox allows relocating them together in one step. Please remember that this feature is still deep in the work-in-progress stage.  [/p][p][b]Changelog[/b]  [/p][p][b]Gameplay[/b]  [/p][list][*][p]Dynamic Cargo Improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Camera Zoom - Hold/Toggle[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Visual[/b]  [/p][list][*][p]Height Blend[/p][/*][/list][p][b]UI[/b][/p][list][*][p]New Profile Creation and Start-up Flow[/p][/*][*][p]Management UI/UX Improvements[/p][/*][/list][p] [b]Other[/b]  [/p][list][*][p]DLC Browser[/p][/*][/list][p]So enjoy all the new additions, but please remember: It's only an open beta, not a stable public version - so you may encounter bugs, instability, or crashes. It's completely okay if you want to wait for the final release. But if you're interested in helping us to get there faster, we'd appreciate all of your feedback on our forum and your bug reports in the [url="https://forum.scssoft.com/viewforum.php?f=340"]dedicated section.[/url]

Please check our modding wiki to get details pertaining to mods for the game.

If you wish to participate in this Open Beta, you can find this version in the Experimental Beta branch on Steam. The way to access it is as follows: Steam client → LIBRARY → right-click on American Truck Simulator  → Properties → Betas tab → Beta Participation drop down menu → public_beta. No password is required. Sometimes you will have to restart your Steam client to see the correct branch name there.

notes.title: Iowa DLC Release
notes.notes:
[p]You don’t need the eyes of a hawk to see what’s coming, the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3025440/American_Truck_Simulator__Iowa/"]Iowa DLC for American Truck Simulator[/url] officially releases today! Get ready to explore everything that the Hawkeye State has to offer.
[/p][h3][b]The Iowa DLC for American Truck Simulator is now released! 
 [/b][/h3][previewyoutube="sVrwp9u93Lk;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
It’s been quite the journey since we first revealed that Iowa was in development, and today, we're thrilled to finally share it with our #BestCommunityEver. With expansive road networks, charming towns, and plenty of jobs across the heart of the Midwest, there’s a lot to look forward to behind the wheel. We're also updating the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2638630/American_Truck_Simulator__Farm_Machinery/"]Farm Machinery DLC [/url]and launching a new World of Trucks event, so be sure to read the full blog to catch all the details surrounding this release.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/9422857fcf35120c8a48396d2dfb2cfda8bfa9df.jpg"][/img]Make the most of your visit to the Hawkeye State and enjoy every moment as you:
[/p][list][*][p]Truck through 12 cities including Des Moines, Cedar Rapids, Dubuque, Burlington, Iowa City, and more![/p][/*][*][p]Discover beautifully recreated landmarks like the Iowa State Capitol, Historic Cedar Covered Bridge, Tree in the Middle of the Road, or the world’s largest grain bins.[/p][/*][*][p]Deliver cargo to or from new depots – the agricultural factory and agricultural dealer.[/p][/*][*][p]Visit the biggest truck stop we have ever built in ATS on Interstate 80![/p][/*][*][p]Become a vital part in transporting farm produce from the Hawkeye State all over the USA.[/p][/*][*][p]Explore more than 15 scenic towns (settlements) on your travels such as Spencer, Clear Lake, Dyersville, Oskaloosa, or Traer![/p][/*][*][p]Pick up and deliver equipment and goods to the Aluminum Factory, a brand-new prefab depot featuring custom-designed assets.[/p][/*][*][p]Admire the state’s stunning expansive hills with terraced fields and picturesque farms.[/p][/*][*][p]Keep goods flowing in and out of Iowa’s huge ethanol plant depots, supporting its lead in U.S. ethanol production.[/p][/*][*][p]Uncover Iowa’s hidden gems, find hidden roads, viewpoints, and more!
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/938fe998bcc53d2ca568dc06724d0fb2db278efa.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/fcfa0cc7c129b0d7d2aad82d09dd9c73c88adf98.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/b0b1af994fbe85c9da6c2529a2fe39c26b8e2255.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/b19ad4a87ba7bf0f329e1a83471021f7a8d3eaf6.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/44cc7f089089f285a1fe07df25e02d6bd344b6fd.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/33d4ee13c90c483ada8ab25b9b5e93d34f1a656a.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/05d561a77278fec0d798bd0266a4408951421364.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Cruise through lively river cities and quiet farming communities as you discover the diverse scenery of Iowa, from elevated prairie hills to expansive fields lined with silos and wind turbines. This map expansion brings detailed landmarks like the Iowa State Capitol and iconic bridges spanning the Mississippi. With a road network featuring major interstates, rural highways, and small-town streets, Iowa offers a unique and immersive journey for any driver![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/321c49b9a0776a2d91823917a18ad689e59c5565.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/055375eeb3686bf807e51715f197ede694686298.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/531698b26959d8da4ac2075c1913e8c940ee1baf.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c540029a70b79ffc4c1e1e145b0018970dda94b5.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c210c75f4f63ad1a282bc9cfeeaa1a5f423d7995.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e54d63f95d8a177add86b6e3e2bca0159b4d8b4a.jpg"][/img]
[b]Farm Machinery DLC Update   

[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/813aebfa787ba3cf7ef6dbdf14d8002b0f9c625e.jpg"][/img][b]
[/b]With the 1.55 update, we introduced a new cargo addition to the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2638630/American_Truck_Simulator__Farm_Machinery/"]Farm Machinery DLC[/url], the Windrower! This essential piece of agricultural equipment is used to gather and align crops into neat rows for drying and harvesting, and now it’s your job to haul it where it’s needed most.  The Windrower will be available on the job market in two color variants: a classic green and a yellow version branded with OWL, one of our in-game farming equipment manufacturers. Designed for lowboy trailers, it’s a wide and impressive load that brings more variety to your agricultural deliveries.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e50a0c187e8d85df673a8b572b4e0901d3995509.jpg"][/img][/p][p]You can find the full details about this update[b] [/b][url="https://blog.scssoft.com/2025/06/155-update-farm-machinery-dlc-update.html"]here.[/url]

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2638630/American_Truck_Simulator__Farm_Machinery/"][/dynamiclink][b]Iowa Freight & Fields Bundle

[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/8b614b7659661a1e284714f32b0ebe008b403fb5.jpg"][/img]
Get ready to haul big cargo in style with the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/56131/Iowa_Freight__Fields/"]Iowa Freight & Fields Bundle for American Truck Simulator![/url] Celebrate the release of the Iowa map expansion, the heart of America's agricultural industry - with this special bundle which includes four DLCs: Iowa, Special Transport, Farm Machinery, and the Retrowave Paint Jobs Pack.[/p][p]Haul farming equipment across Iowa with the Farm Machinery DLC, from the iconic I-80 to the capital city of Des Moines, and through charming towns along the Mississippi River, and put your driving skills to the test with oversized cargo from the Special Transport DLC.[/p][p]Top it all off with bold, retro flair drive in vibrant ‘80s style with the Retrowave Paint Jobs Pack as you cruise through the Hawkeye State.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Cruising Iowa World of Trucks Event

[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/0776bd067288d522185d59691d2c0c36f1d4f099.jpg"][/img][b]
[/b]Right with the release of this map expansion, we are also introducing the [url="https://blog.scssoft.com/2025/07/cruising-iowa-world-of-trucks-event.html"]#CruisingIowa World of Trucks Event[/url] for you to enjoy! We challenge our #BestCommunityEver to achieve a collective goal of driving 125,000,000 miles while delivering cargo to or from any city in Iowa. The personal goal is to deliver cargo to or from all 12 cities in the Hawkeye State, with each job being 100 miles or more. You can read more about the event here.[/p][p][/p][p]Unique rewards await those who complete the challenge! Truckers who achieve their personal goal will earn the Golden Flight ATS truck paint job and a World of Trucks Achievement.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4d9f86a8066b5bb2fecc56657d3991cb01ecebda.jpg"][/img]When the community goal is met, and if you’ve also completed your personal goal, you’ll receive the beautifully crafted Porcelain Wild Rose hanging ornament for your cabin.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/8d95ac0abd7ea509842cbb6e541452b909f2630b.jpg"][/img]But that’s not all, truckers who complete a job using External Contracts or the External Market[b] TO or FROM Iowa City[/b] will be rewarded with the Happy Hog cabin plush! Soft, snuggly, and full of Midwestern charm, this cheerful piglet pays tribute to Iowa’s proud farming heritage and is sure to keep you company on your travels! 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/1f1fb5be9577145404e38e94467a743d859de437.jpg"][/img]We can’t wait for you to start trucking through the Hawkeye State. Don’t forget to tag us in your photos and videos using the hashtag #CruisingIowa on [url="https://x.com/SCSsoftware"]X/Twitter[/url], [url="https://www.facebook.com/americantrucksimulator.scs/"]Facebook[/url], [url="https://www.instagram.com/scs.software"]Instagram[/url],and [url="https://bsky.app/profile/scssoft.com"]Bluesky[/url]. If you’re enjoying your time #CruisingIowa, we’d really appreciate it if you left a review on the Iowa DLC Steam store page. We thank you for all your support and until next time, keep on truckin'!

notes.title: American Truck Simulator: 1.55 Update Release
notes.notes:
[p]We’re excited to share with our community that the 1.55 update for [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/"]American Truck Simulator[/url] is now officially released! This update brings new content, implementations, fixes, quality of life improvements, and more. Let’s dive in and take a look at what’s in store.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e895fa9e38e4a456cb0f18e1db64b40c71516770.jpg"][/img]

We’d also like to give a huge shoutout to everyone who participated in the Open Beta, shared feedback, and reported bugs. Your invaluable contributions have helped us fine tune the content and fix issues that initially slipped through the cracks. We hope that you will enjoy the new features, changes, and more that come with this update. [/p][previewyoutube="we_zmfTVaAE;full"][/previewyoutube][p][b]
Driving Academy - Truck Driving Proficiency
[/b][/p][previewyoutube="jXEfpl0jWM0;full"][/previewyoutube][p]This new Driving Academy module, called Truck Driving Proficiency, will introduce a set of much more challenging scenarios, which will test even the most skilled drivers to the limit. For this new module and set of scenarios, we will also introduce a new reward system. The most important thing is still to precisely complete a scenario by driving along the designated path and avoiding any collisions.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/5bdc9a5c5a05c5f7ae99f9f8df561e0eca04c8d2.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/6bef522a94ad8b0367d644f97ddd79011d2a1bd4.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/ae60ba88bd63f82e9c94ab4f46724df55e5f0d6e.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/280090ee67cce826157aac1cb877a2e9ed18e0f3.jpg"][/img]
Players will also be able to achieve up to 3 collectable stars in this module, which can be earned by meeting additional conditions such as only using the interior camera, limiting gear shifts between drive and reverse, or completing the scenario in the set time. To really test your skills, you won't find any pre-recorded video tutorials, and you will have to use all the knowledge we taught you in our first module of Driving Academy.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/2afa70a1ee8fa61a43c798cfbbba3143d3fef2f2.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/0bd22c3c50d2aaffb35fbea5307509f818a4ecf9.jpg"][/img]
We've also prepared new, exciting rewards that players can use on the same profile in the base game! As you may know, finishing the first module grants a blue traffic cone cabin accessory and a customizable Driving Academy truck paint job. Completing all Truck Driving Proficiency scenarios unlocks an orange traffic cone accessory, while earning 3 stars in every scenario adds a matching trailer paint job and a golden traffic cone, giving your truck and trailer the full Driving Academy look.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Asynchronous Loading[/b]

We have been hard at work implementing a major overhaul in the way our game loads and processes data, a new system we call Asynchronous Loading. This system is designed to improve the loading process by ensuring that the game and loading screens remain uninterrupted while assets are loaded in the background. The primary benefit here is the mitigation of stuttering, resulting in a smoother experience overall.

We’d like to extend a sincere thank you to everyone who shared their feedback during both the Experimental and Open Beta phases. Your input played a key role in helping us refine this system, and we’re excited to share that Asynchronous Loading is now fully implemented with the release of the 1.55 update![/p][p][/p][p][b]Fifth Generation Freightliner Cascadia Update[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/3ce898ea4880403c1d52039cd10e9370d6dc91dd.jpg"][/img][/p][p]
A range of new accessories and improvements have been made to the Fifth Generation Freightliner Cascadia. From a paintable airdam and sunvisor to chrome mirror and filter options, you’ll have more ways than ever to personalize your truck’s look. Inside the cabin, you can now choose from updated tan, grey, or the newly added black interiors, along with either a classic or modern dashboard layout, bringing the total to six interior variants per sleeper![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/fdaee6999cf1e6ba387c977a2db03ee734da411f.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/cfe66010f2550bfddec3717d4a90575eab42e2b8.jpg"][/img]
Exterior updates include refinements to the 72" sleeper side walls, improved blind spot sensors compatible with both traditional and digital mirrors, and revised camera arms with more accurate turn indicator behavior. We've also smashed some bugs along with this update too!
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/b00849979119d2f98d98bcbc18eb92fa21249e74.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/257cc4409c7a50a9d8f4b0cef17775d321f63592.jpg"][/img]
You can check out the full list of changes and additions at this [url="https://blog.scssoft.com/2025/06/ats-155-update-freightliner-cascadia.html"]blogpost.[/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]Kenworth T680 Update
[/b][/p][p]The Kenworth T680 is getting an update! First released in December 2023 to celebrate Kenworth’s 100th anniversary, the truck was developed on an accelerated schedule with help from Kenworth’s team. Now, we’re expanding its customization options to give players even more control over how their truck looks and performs.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4dc951249efd874e58adf698fc05e5a15bf55a02.jpg"][/img]
Players will be able to choose between three cab variants as we are adding the 52" Mid-Roof and the 76" High-Roof, offering more flexibility and personality on the road. The chassis lineup will expand by seven configurations, including 6x4 options for all cabs in both short and long hood versions, as well as 4x2 setups specifically for day cabs.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/8d173fbf67cd7c0ad6beafe0e2c224cf4e51f214.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/d3ffb709146b8be5a1c60133df3dc9937ef2ec5e.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c79d7f7c7acbb475e0f149b9c8ddeceada591b9a.jpg"][/img]
A total of 20 interior variants will be added: eight for the 76" High-Roof cab and eight for the 52" Mid-Roof, each in both single and double bunk layouts, plus four tailored for the day cab. Every interior will come in Diamond VIT and Vantage trims, with stylish Tan and Grey color options.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/0cd6ef59941944f2649bfbf3c670778264f14ce6.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/d91fc7081ce49cc50c520e2716bda77e560a9769.jpg"][/img]
Under the hood, drivers will have even more options, as we are adding seven powerful engine variants from the Cummins X12 and X15 series, and also five new transmission options to match their driving style. To top it off, all paint jobs, including those from DLCs, are now fully compatible with the T680. Whether you're going for style, performance, or both, the updated T680 offers everything you need to create your perfect rig.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/5419edbac6037d115feb6115d579ebdb92080c82.jpg"][/img]
Check out the full dedicated blog to read about all the changes and updates coming with this [url="https://blog.scssoft.com/2025/06/155-update-kenworth-t680-update.html"]update here[/url]![b]

New additional content for the Nebraska DLC

[/b]New roads ahead! We're happy to share that with 1.55, a free update has rolled out for all owners of the Nebraska DLC. 
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/52fd7a5dd2cd329a370ad25e9d4385c6667feebe.jpg"][/img]
This addition expands the northeastern corner of the state with three key highways; The US-20, US-75, and US-81. On these new routes, drivers can discover a new truck stop, a weigh station, and several scenic landmarks.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/3e305823b216c1d300e33f3f5e420be13c318cec.jpg"][/img]
You’ll also now be able to travel through the settlement of Laurel, offering a slice of small-town charm rooted in farming heritage. Whether you're just free-roaming or passing through with a delivery nearby, there's even more reason to revisit the Cornhusker State.

Check out the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2543810/American_Truck_Simulator__Nebraska/"]Nebraska DLC for American Truck Simulator on Steam here.[/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]Farm Machinery DLC Update[/b][/p][p]We’re excited to introduce a new free cargo addition to the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2638630/American_Truck_Simulator__Farm_Machinery/"]Farm Machinery DLC[/url], the Windrower! This essential piece of agricultural equipment is used to gather and align crops into neat rows for drying and harvesting, and now it’s your job to haul it where it’s needed most.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/813aebfa787ba3cf7ef6dbdf14d8002b0f9c625e.jpg"][/img]
The Windrower will be available on the job market in two color variants: a classic green and a yellow version branded with OWL, one of our in-game farming equipment manufacturers. Designed for lowboy trailers, it’s a wide and impressive load that brings more variety to your agricultural deliveries.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/7db0c55610f9181b83b27d28184d0183f65704ab.jpg"][/img][/p][p]You can find the full details about this update[b] [/b][url="https://blog.scssoft.com/2025/06/155-update-farm-machinery-dlc-update.html"]here[/url].[b]

FlowBelow Painted Parts

[/b]We're introducing a visual enhancement for select trucks featuring FlowBelow aerodynamic parts in American Truck Simulator. These drive wheel closeouts, designed to improve fuel efficiency and airflow, now come with the option to be paintable.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/83c97dc2d9e9f7412fcfe0ca6031ec894f5774a1.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/bd17e79b28d44f7ce718aae6d25cab666fcde513.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/2f0a43314e015ab07d21abcdb128b1eeab3259e3.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/1006e4b3585717ad9dbbaf30041fd430cce663ac.jpg"][/img]
This means players can now customize these components to match their truck’s color scheme, creating a more polished and unified appearance. Whether you're aiming for a clean fleet aesthetic or giving your rig a show truck vibe, we’re confident this small update will help you tailor your truck even more to your personal style.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/9527206885aa07272cfb7e421d1514e52a0f30b0.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/f8c68f4c4814677239d0a1bed77f2e26cd1f58e4.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/ae1ddfd4310eee8892e95d32a3ae2532fe52cd2e.jpg"][/img]
Don’t forget to share your fresh paint jobs with us on our social media channels!
[b]
Custom City Intros for New Mexico DLC[/b][/p][p]With this update, [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/684630/American_Truck_Simulator__New_Mexico/"]New Mexico[/url] has received several new Custom City Intros! These special cutscenes play when a player selects a starting city while creating a new profile.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e3b607d85164a4043ff2d9feeb081d6e9959c46e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]You’ll now find these intros available for the following cities in New Mexico:[/p][list][*][p]    Farmington[/p][/*][*][p]    Las Cruces[/p][/*][*][p]    Roswell[/p][/*][*][p]    Santa Fe[/p][/*][/list][p]We hope that new players, or those starting afresh, will enjoy these additions, which showcase the area where your journey begins!  

[b]Mail UX Redesign
[/b]
The mail screen has been reworked to provide a cleaner layout and a smoother navigation experience. Messages are now displayed in a two-column format, with a scrollable list on the left and an enlarged message view on the right for better readability. Messages load from the top, and when the list gets longer, intuitive paging helps keep things tidy. Navigation has been improved across all input methods, and embedded links or actions can now be accessed directly from the message content.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/1d17cd9ce137bd9dd124ed49e1fb5913fa319779.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Options QoL Improvements

[/b]In this update, we’ve added a small but useful quality-of-life improvement to the graphics settings menu. You’ll now see example screenshots next to various settings, giving you a better idea of how each option affects the game’s visuals.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/257037ec32065191ac5ca3ae01b05747aac6d228.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/9257afed5d1c5d7b31cae48047d1275b17cfbebd.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Whether you're tweaking things for smoother performance or aiming for the best possible look, these previews should make it easier to find the right balance for your setup.[b]

Map Improvements - "My Location" Hotkey

[/b]We are adding a "My Location" hotkey as part of our map improvements. When pressed, it instantly centers the game map on the player's current location. We hope you find this small addition useful on the road!
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/f4cbbe2d6b22ab4488f1830fe1173f0839d04a76.jpg"][/img][b]
Change of Steam Achievements 
[/b][/p][p]Our team is working around the clock on engine updates, many of which are not visible during regular gameplay. Some of these are visible instantly, such as new light systems, but we also need to work on changes that are not normally visible when you play.[/p][p]Updating the achievement system gives us foundations that will allow us to make different and new types of achievements, as well as manage existing ones that often rely on different DLCs and regions. As a part of that, we have a new system coming out in 1.55.[/p][p]Along with this new system, some small changes were made to existing achievements and their goals to prepare us for any changes future developments may bring. If you would like to share any feedback about this, you can do so on our forums.[/p][p]
[b]Changelog[/b]

[b]Gameplay[/b][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Driving Academy - Truck Driving Proficiency[/p][/*][*][p]Map Improvements - "My Location" Hotkey[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Map[/b][/p][list][*][p]New additional content for the Nebraska DLC - US-20, US-81, US-75 & the settlement of Laurel [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Vehicles[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fifth Generation Freightliner Cascadia Update[/p][/*][*][p]Kenworth T680 Update[/p][/*][*][p]FlowBelow Painted Parts[/p][/*][*][p]Farm Machinery DLC Update [/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]Visual[/b][/p][list][*][p]Custom city intros for New Mexico DLC[/p][/*][*][p]Mail UX redesign[/p][/*][*][p]Options QoL Improvements - Graphics settings visualisation[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]Other[/b][/p][list][*][p]Steam achievements update with text and icon improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Save manager improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Asynchronous loading[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Iowa Release Date + Video Trailer Reveal
notes.notes:
[p]Are you ready to explore the Hawkeye State? Mark your calendars and get ready to hit the road, because we're excited to announce that the...
[/p][h2]Iowa DLC for American Truck Simulator
will be released on July 10th, 2025.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/03e651c683d0425391261e18910967891482c8ee.jpg"][/img][/h2][p]We're just as excited as you are, and to keep the anticipation rolling, we've released the official video trailer for the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3025440/American_Truck_Simulator__Iowa/"]Iowa DLC[/url] on our [url="https://www.youtube.com/SCSSoftware"]YouTube channel[/url]! Created by our talented video team, this trailer offers a first look at the stunning landscapes, iconic landmarks, vibrant cities, industries, and hidden gems that await you in this map expansion. Check it out below 👇
[/p][previewyoutube="sVrwp9u93Lk;full"][/previewyoutube][p]As we get closer to release, our teams are focused on polishing the final elements of Iowa to ensure everything rolls out smoothly. We cannot wait for you to take your first journey!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/5368c96e9e61f2924ce0a8ba9543d52714bd1619.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/938fe998bcc53d2ca568dc06724d0fb2db278efa.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/fcfa0cc7c129b0d7d2aad82d09dd9c73c88adf98.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/b0b1af994fbe85c9da6c2529a2fe39c26b8e2255.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/b19ad4a87ba7bf0f329e1a83471021f7a8d3eaf6.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/25190b4181a36965abdf1a90558ae5c892bc7fdc.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c08ad6932c98ebb4051ee28f20fbad630551397d.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/44cc7f089089f285a1fe07df25e02d6bd344b6fd.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/33d4ee13c90c483ada8ab25b9b5e93d34f1a656a.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/05d561a77278fec0d798bd0266a4408951421364.jpg"][/img]
Whether you're making deliveries to vibrant cities like Cedar Rapids and Iowa City or cruising along scenic back roads through terraced fields and rolling farmland, Iowa offers a truly authentic trucking experience. Be sure to watch for unique roadside attractions, hidden roads, and shortcuts around industries, there’s always something new to discover!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e54d63f95d8a177add86b6e3e2bca0159b4d8b4a.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/ad3f221e2a096f0d082e7906893fd9e3b8cf7926.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/36a8f192ab5aa21c669af6ebdafef055035feafa.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c540029a70b79ffc4c1e1e145b0018970dda94b5.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/531698b26959d8da4ac2075c1913e8c940ee1baf.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/055375eeb3686bf807e51715f197ede694686298.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/321c49b9a0776a2d91823917a18ad689e59c5565.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/94a0cc5142fb1a8c8c4513420313a0c169a6bfb7.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/295d12b99baa2ca1c9c22e9081234fd311e3626e.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c443d7de9441dc3dcf104007471d1d5eb481b083.jpg"][/img]
Excited to get trucking? There's not long to wait! In the meantime, be sure to add the Iowa DLC to your Steam Wishlist! It really helps support our work and notifies you of its release. We thank you for all your support! We look forward to seeing you on the road in Iowa, until then, keep on Truckin'.

notes.title: 1.55 Update: Kenworth T680 Update
notes.notes: [p]In December 2023, we released the [url="https://blog.scssoft.com/2023/12/kenworth-t680-100-years-anniversary.html"]Kenworth T680 Anniversary Edition[/url]. Now, with the upcoming 1.55 update for [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/"]American Truck Simulator[/url], we will introduce more customization options for this beautiful truck, including new cabins, chassis, interior designs, and more![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/2fc1ed2a26d268c4a7229754cc4a1087cdee402c.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The initial release of this truck was done on a super-accelerated schedule as we wanted to bring it to our #BestCommunityEver for Kenworth's 100 years celebration, and we made it happen on time thanks to smooth cooperation with experts from [url="https://www.kenworth.com/"]Kenworth[/url]. Now you will be able to truly customize this beauty of a truck thanks to the additional work of our vehicle team![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/9e50904582f9ef3d15dd3882cee931f8433bf4f0.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/0361c8a5e01075e1f83404d528580ce3df4a2f5a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Players will be able to choose between three cab variants as we are adding the 52" Mid-Roof and the 76" High-Roof, offering more flexibility and personality on the road. The chassis lineup will expand by seven configurations, including 6x4 options for all cabs in both short and long hood versions, as well as 4x2 setups specifically for day cabs.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/89ab90992726a642a7b7b56d537cf671865518dc.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/edf68690cf49bfae84ec73c8bebe612ef74f030c.jpg"][/img][/p][p]A total of 20 interior variants will be added: eight for the 76" High-Roof cab and eight for the 52" Mid-Roof, each in both single and double bunk layouts, plus four tailored for the day cab. Every interior will come in Diamond VIT and Vantage trims, with stylish Tan and Grey color options.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/4e4b1a6ca69f82e5c906e1aec32605c99bae2f4f.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/a7cab483369d70c4d9f503bd2ab663ebc0d1cbdb.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Under the hood, drivers will have even more options, as we are adding seven powerful engine variants from the Cummins X12 and X15 series, and also five new transmission choices to match their driving style.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/f14b82ba957e24b837d491d34fdb4031ef9c37f5.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/a77652d0a28faef1e7a4bb320250f963e9663462.jpg"][/img][/p][p]A massive range of new accessories will come too, giving you the freedom to personalize nearly every aspect of your rig. This includes bumpers in both chrome and painted finishes. Cab extenders will be available for all cabin types, and classic exhausts are being added for the Day Cab and 52" cab. You'll also find chrome detailing for the front grill and side filters, plus two hood versions, short and long, designed to accommodate larger engines.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/86cd450d3314b7f659ebab31666d6943f6391bd9.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/7331f3cd8b9dbfa9dfe91a3ad2e04393ceb36552.jpg"][/img][/p][p]New physical mirror models will come in both chrome and painted variants, and white fenders will give a fresh look to your setup. For even more customization, you'll be able to add or remove aero kits, chassis skid plates, and deck plates in a variety of styles. Vent-style side windows, removable rear extenders, and three new steering wheel variants will add even more flexibility. And yes, removable sun visors will now be available across all cabs.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/6980311f2f898961c6ebc213393dba1e258a27f3.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/d29df54321c3ff40802f7fa43ec4580729cd84ed.jpg"][/img][/p][p]And to tie it all together, all paint jobs, including those from DLCs, will now be fully compatible with this truck, giving you even more options to create your perfect ride.[/p][p]Get ready for the ride of your life with the updated Kenworth T680 when the 1.55 update releases! Don't forget to give our [url="https://twitter.com/SCSsoftware"]X/Twitter[/url], [url="https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/"]Instagram[/url], [url="https://www.facebook.com/scssoft"]Facebook[/url], [url="https://bsky.app/profile/scssoft.com"]Bluesky[/url], and [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@scssoftware"]TikTok[/url] a follow as you'll receive updates about our games straight to your feed, or [url="https://www.scssoft.com/newsletter"]subscribe to our newsletter[/url] to stay informed. Safe travels![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: 1.55 Update: Farm Machinery DLC Update
notes.notes:
[p]We're always working on new ways to keep things fresh on the road! Today, we're happy to share that in our upcoming 1.55 update for American Truck Simulator, we're bringing a small free update to the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2638630/American_Truck_Simulator__Farm_Machinery/"]Farm Machinery DLC[/url] that includes a new cargo! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e002899ea3f6fb0ef80e982f49fdca7af2bbd483.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Say hello to the Windrower! If you’ve ever seen neat rows of cut hay or crops lined up across a field, this is the machine behind that magic. Windrowers are used to cut and gather crops like hay or grains into long, tidy rows called windrows. This process helps the crops dry faster and makes it easier for the next machines, like balers or harvesters, to come in and collect them.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/8c1a611850daf5b454ada94ad17514910544c8db.jpg"][/img][/p][p]They're big, wide, and built for the fields, but when it’s time to move them, it takes a skilled trucker with a lowboy trailer to get the job done. It'll come in two color variants, there’s a green variant that looks right at home on any farm, and a yellow one that proudly features the logo of OWL, one of our in-game farming equipment brands.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/8ff402d3008ec4fbb498c5bae314c857fba00f91.jpg"][/img][/p][p]So whether you're hauling a Windrower between farms, or delivering one from the depot, we hope you’ll enjoy this new addition to our DLC. We can’t wait to see your screenshots from the road.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/d193ad1a1fdcaff4449f0336ab9d20fce1a6d8ff.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We look forward to seeing you haul this new cargo on the road in the near future! Until then, make sure to keep upto date with all the latest American Truck Simulator news, by following us on [url="https://x.com/SCSsoftware"]X/Twitter[/url], [url="https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/"]Instagram[/url], [url="https://www.facebook.com/americantrucksimulator.scs/"]Facebook[/url] & [url="https://bsky.app/profile/scssoft.com"]Bluesky[/url]. Until next time, keep on truckin’!

[url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2638630/American_Truck_Simulator__Farm_Machinery/"]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2638630/American_Truck_Simulator__Farm_Machinery/[/url][/p]

notes.title: ATS 1.55 Update: Freightliner Cascadia 2024 Update
notes.notes:
As part of the upcoming 1.55 update for American Truck Simulator, we’re excited to introduce a range of improvements and new customization options for the Freightliner Cascadia 2024. This includes new accessories, updated interior and exterior options, and more. Let’s take a closer look, shall we?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c6afeafb7ec24656c4034a37c86a71d46e558221.jpg[/img]
Several new accessories have been added to allow for even greater personalization of your Freightliner Cascadia. This includes a paintable airdam, a vertical exhaust system, chrome side mirrors and filter fins, and a paintable sunvisor for the sleeper variant. We hope these additions make it easier than ever to fine-tune your Cascadia’s appearance to match your style or virtual trucking company's branding! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/53df5eab2ab9ddbe6a09963976e11fa0d0ace76e.jpg[/img]
Inside the cabin, we've added a new black interior variant, while also updating the existing tan and grey versions. Drivers will also have the choice between a traditional gauge cluster on their dashboard or a modern digital dashboard layout. With these additions, each sleeper configuration now includes six unique interior variants, giving you more options for your cabin.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/bfab7ddbf51b89379f4e7415e363722291860e82.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/07cd1e701e90765e054c388aa0e6ae2fd73dd7df.jpg[/img]
On the exterior, we’ve worked on improving the sleeper's details as well. The 72" sleeper side walls have been remodelled, particularly around the window area. Blind spot sensors have also received an update, allowing them to function correctly with both the traditional A-pillar sensors and the digital mirror displays. The camera arms have also been adjusted, with their marker lights now functioning solely as turn indicators, reflecting real-world behavior more accurately.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4b15b4747faaf6e768933546139338c9011d935d.jpg[/img]
Alongside these updates, we’ve made several under-the-hood improvements, including various bug fixes and animation updates to enhance your overall driving experience with the Freightliner Cascadia.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/02a3ead91da5493cf01a7e68777cd7091d669f79.jpg[/img]
We’d like to thank our partners at Freightliner for their ongoing cooperation. We hope you enjoy the refreshed Freightliner Cascadia experience, and we look forward to seeing how you make it your own when 1.55 update rolls out. Until next time, keep on truckin'!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3272290/American_Truck_Simulator__Freightliner_Cascadia_The_Fifth_Generation/

notes.title: Star Nation 2025 Update
notes.notes:
We are returning to Bend, Oregon, from the 6th to 9th June to take part in [url=https://www.westernstartrucks.com/]Western Star[/url]'s unforgettable Star Nation Experience 2025! Along with us, Western Star Trucks, and members of the Star Nation community, two lucky American Truck Simulator players had the chance to win this all-expenses-paid trip, so let's meet them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/194af43f93e26137e4b6a70bd0d5c0dea13328da.jpg[/img]
Last year, we were honored to join Western Star Trucks for the 2024 Star Nation Experience - an adrenaline-filled adventure in Oregon's rugged wilderness. From off-road trucking and fly fishing to ATV thrills, it was an unforgettable celebration of the Western Star community. A standout moment was the behind-the-scenes tour and driver challenge at Daimler Truck's High Desert Proving Grounds in Madras. You can watch our SCS On The Road episode from last year's event below. And this year promises just as much excitement.

[previewyoutube=dQ5DDzLEPjo;full][/previewyoutube]
Last week, Western Star announced the winners they selected - not just from their own community, but from ours as well, inviting two ATS players to join the experience. They're also bringing back two past SNE alumni, Casey LaDelle and Tatiana DeYoung, as coaches for this year's Get Tough Challenge. As mentioned earlier, we're excited to be part of this unique event, with Oscar and Beny representing us. They'll be meeting the incredible group of winners and the Western Star team while also capturing the entire weekend to create a special SCS On The Road episode. Now, let's meet the two participants from the #BestCommunityEver!

[h3]Tyler[/h3]
Tyler works for a construction company that specializes in large-scale infrastructure projects - an industry where dependable, heavy-duty equipment is essential. Off the job site, he's an avid American Truck Simulator player, finding a unique connection between his real-world experience and his passion for virtual trucking. What stands out most to him is the level of authenticity and detail brought to Western Star trucks in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/c2eed48df693d16a8b3448b2994cff70486e17dc.png[/img]
"Western Stars feel like the last tough trucks out there. The new 49X is one tough truck that gives a comfortable experience," he says, having driven the truck in real life, he truly appreciates its power and comfort.

[h3]Alex[/h3]
Alex is a dedicated fan of Western Star and American Truck Simulator, with a connection to the brand dating back to his childhood. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/117c133ae8bacf0d1b33e03f46b877fe0db6df4b.png[/img]
"My parents met in Portland, and on a visit there as a kid, I saw my first Western Star tridem log truck, and it left an impression. It has become my favorite brand to play with, logging thousands of miles in both an SFA and an SBA 49X. I had a medical event 7 years ago that left me barely able to walk when I was at my worst in the hospital. I have fought back, working through years of PT and exercises to regain it, so the #NeverBackDown isn't just a slogan for me, it's a mantra for how to break through such a curveball."

We would like to thank Western Star Trucks for this wonderful opportunity to be a part of this adventure again, along with the members of our community. Keep a close eye on Western Star's [url=https://www.facebook.com/westernstartrucks]Facebook[/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/westernstartruck]Instagram[/url], and our [url=https://twitter.com/SCSsoftware]X/Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/@SCSSoftware/]YouTube[/url], [url=https://bsky.app/profile/scssoft.com]Bluesky[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/scssoft]Facebook[/url] so you don't miss out on any news from the Star Nation Experience 2025, which Oscar and Benny from our team will also attend. Oregon, here we come!

notes.title: Kenworth W900 Legacy Edition Release
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce a very special addition to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/]American Truck Simulator[/url], The Kenworth W900 Legacy Edition! This limited-edition truck pays tribute to the long-standing heritage of the W900, a true icon that has been a staple of the North American highway since its debut in 1963.

[previewyoutube=9a0HkpG9IoA;full][/previewyoutube]
With over 280,000 units produced since its release, the W900 has left a significant mark on the industry. The Legacy Edition celebrates that rich history, and we’re honored to have the opportunity to recreate this special edition of the W900 for American Truck Simulator for all players to experience and enjoy.

Inside the cab, you’ll find a luxurious Black Diamond VIT interior, featuring platinum accents and vintage tuck-and-roll upholstery on the sleeper’s back wall. Ravenwood trim on the dash and doors is paired with legacy Kenworth logos and elegant platinum stitching.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/7bb1984d4ad327e2655e1afa608595fe450777a8.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/851d5e68030179b9e01434ea972cae718ee58e6a.jpg[/img]
We’ve also recreated the new vintage-style interior options for the Day Cab, 72" Flat Roof Sleeper, and 86" Studio Sleeper configurations. These include legacy seats, period-correct trim, and a legacy badged steering wheel with platinum accent stitching.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/5990471b4f4ba0d498f720d9dd269538f28fca0a.jpg[/img]
On the exterior, the W900 Legacy Edition features several design elements inspired by the original 1963 model, including classic Kenworth hood badges and special paint schemes that reflect the truck’s origins. In addition, we’ve introduced a range of new customization options.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e2cb099103dbf81758cc1018ec5e86f026451632.jpg[/img]
These include a heritage-style bumper, a new hood with painted extensions, legacy-style exhausts, rear mudflaps featuring the original Kenworth logo, and modern air filters available in both painted and chrome variants. Players can also equip mirrors with integrated blinkers, new horn options, and cabflares.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4587e9688fa3600c5326586d81035e546ccd7d70.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/69aff4a23997aa5368d90cd4cb373d2e08924298.jpg[/img]
Through the years, the Kenworth W900 has made its mark with a variety of special edition trucks, each of which featured its own unique paint job. We're excited to share that we have faithfully recreated each of these for you to use on the W900 in American Truck Simulator, including:[list]
[*] Midnight Sun
[*] Gold Nugget
[*] Liberty VIT 200
[*] Shasta
[*] Yukon
[*] Icon
[*] Yosemite
[*] Comet
[*] VIT Edition
[*] VIT Edition Metallic
[*] Oh Canada![/list]
Each one is designed to highlight the unique spirit of this legendary truck. We hope you enjoy customising your rig with these iconic paint jobs!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/7aaee5de46220282c19aea79fbeb0add984c25fa.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/7bea0f93746f33efbecc8143d74e6e6b06326804.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/81b90ebe375626d8dfbabfc78677d9fb7dfba7e6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/95cd1a9e5117add69229742a15e38e9aaef528f1.jpg[/img]
As part of this update, we’re adding a new cabin variant for the Kenworth W900, the 72" Flat Roof Sleeper, as well as featuring the classic split windshield. These new additions are compatible with all existing paint job DLCs and the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2386530/American_Truck_Simulator__W900_Tuning_Pack/]W900 Tuning Pack[/url], ensuring players have full freedom to customise their truck.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/ed25129bb5ada0fee04ccd14c6e50d09bcf8d2a0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/1ab96d70b797591effb0774dd79c5d860d22e952.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/b310e92158ce2c7b034ee92077800ba0588fd8c6.jpg[/img]
We’d like to thank our good friends at Kenworth Trucks for allowing us to bring this special, limited edition to the virtual roads of American Truck Simulator. We know how much our players enjoy trucking with the W900, and we’re proud to be part of this farewell to an icon of the American highway.

Be sure to share your screenshots, videos, and more with us and Kenworth Trucks on social media using the hashtag #W900Legacy, we’d love to see and share them! We hope you enjoy hitting the road in American Truck Simulator with the Kenworth W900 Legacy Edition. Until next time, keep on truckin’.

notes.title: Missouri DLC Release
notes.notes:
We don't need to show you more of the Show-Me State - now you can explore it yourself because it officially releases today! Power up your engines and get ready to explore everything that [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2730870/American_Truck_Simulator__Missouri/]Missouri[/url] has to offer.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2730870/American_Truck_Simulator__Missouri/][h3]The Missouri DLC is now available![/h3][/url]
[previewyoutube=2fcExHj6kEI;full][/previewyoutube]
It has been over a year since we announced that our teams are working on the Missouri map expansion and we are so excited to be able to finally bring it to our #BestCommunityEver. There is plenty of new content waiting for you. And along with the map expansion, we are also updating the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/620610/American_Truck_Simulator__Heavy_Cargo_Pack/]Heavy Cargo Pack[/url] and Special Transport DLCs so read until the end to find out more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/ac39ba004a8d6672710ed5cfb1f846554c917957.jpg[/img]
Make the most of your visit to the wonderful Show Me State and enjoy every moment as you discover:
[list]
[*] 12 meticulously recreated cities including St. Louis, Kansas City, St. Joseph, and Jefferson City.
[*] See beautiful landmarks scattered across Missouri such as the iconic Gateway Arch in St. Louis, Missouri State Capitol in Jefferson City, the City Hall in Cape Girardeau and many more!
[*] Deliver new cargo and discover fresh industries such as a superstructure factory, feedmill and a historic beverage factory.
[*] Enjoy trucking through 9 scenic towns (settlements).
[*] Drive across the impressively large Bagnell Dam.
[*] Visit Springfield, the birthplace of Route 66.
[*] Transport goods to four unique underground warehouses.
[*] Stop by the beautiful Lake of the Ozarks and explore the vast Ozark Mountains.
[*] Uncover the hidden treasures of Missouri's countryside, forests, viewpoints, road network and more.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/a742414faffd72a979333caac0ba2badf51fb417.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/3b1d8683446007957faf37164643d82c2151d543.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/32e3e7e76de4365a45746794e5a55421c3f043ec.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/48647f925cc651de7dfd11d81d0a58d7f3c7ee7e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/3f6a650e6d6f216f07a744845e7dcd9b77a2cebb.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/f2a2093b5a70266b3f8cfc430f940625b8c37afc.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/6bc5ca15792d44a169f7542d3fac4165ce881029.jpg[/img]
Cruise through huge buzzing cities or quiet little towns. Explore the state's diverse landscapes, from the rolling Ozarks to vast farmlands. New depots & cargoes, iconic landmarks, beautiful nature, and stunning underground warehouses bring the state's rich character to life and add realism to your trucking adventures. Whether you're navigating urban streets in St. Louis or cruising through serene countryside, Missouri offers a diverse and exciting trucking experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/2aac64d863b122d6c8d4847326f9d89dd127e94c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/82cf9a750eab23106111d44a24d1b0030d1ea2e1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/55027542998bd64c274172b31b5ea8c43a1a68cc.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/1cd46ac12e21618f93ae900248ac9b17b5a73ade.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/887e010f9e2db41d32e3269bfc17fc3e05ee585e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/38e9e41167b6bce3869073e0243c9b94099d473d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/254fa5bbca42fd32e946e44775698e0b7fbec209.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/34c2a5c25dc3958f80679149bb1b221a9cbc6ac1.jpg[/img]
[h3]Special Transport DLC Update[/h3]
With the release of Missouri, we're updating the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/962750/American_Truck_Simulator__Special_Transport/]Special Transport DLC[/url] as we do with every new map expansion! This update brings three new routes for oversized cargo deliveries across the Show Me State. If you own this popular DLC, you'll be able to transport heavy hauls along these routes: Kansas City to Rolla, Cape Girardeau to Springfield, and St. Louis to Kirksville.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/6f9a3738c965ca430407feaff382ffb4a076085b.jpg[/img]
But that's not all as we are also adding a brand new cargo for this DLC - a huge underground electric loader which is used in the underground mining industry where it can operate quickly in tough conditions. If you think you've got what it takes to take on the challenge of transporting these cargoes, make sure to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/962750/American_Truck_Simulator__Special_Transport/#game_area_purchase]get the Special Transport DLC on Steam now[/url]!

[h3]Heavy Cargo DLC Update[/h3]
Our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/620610/American_Truck_Simulator__Heavy_Cargo_Pack/]Heavy Cargo Pack[/url] is getting an upgrade as well with three new cargoes - a Mobile Screener, a Mobile Crusher, and a Mobile Stacker which are all used in material processing mainly in mining.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/3e27d7f6f36d512af77b46e264ce84e947be9801.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/4e3ed94c32aa30696d6f8ba1a8e2d72c787bd79a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/45489528a7784277b819c06fae7fd5445f891213.jpg[/img]

Enjoy this upcoming map expansion to the fullest and amplify your trucking experience with new loads from the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/620610/American_Truck_Simulator__Heavy_Cargo_Pack/]Heavy Cargo Pack DLC[/url] which you can get on Steam.

[h3]Missouri Mighty Haul Bundle[/h3]
If you plan to get the Missouri DLC and enjoy hauling heavy and oversized cargo, be sure to check out our new [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/51994/Missouri_Mighty_Haul/]Missouri Mighty Haul Bundle[/url] which we will release along with the map expansion. It includes not only the Missouri DLC but also the Heavy Cargo Pack and Special Transport DLCs. But that's not all! This bundle also comes with the Classic Stripes Paint Jobs Pack, allowing you to decorate your truck with stunning paint jobs.

Plus, the bundle operates on a "Complete the Set" basis, meaning you'll only pay for the DLCs that you don't already own. Get it now on Steam!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/8002e36a0ca162a98c9c51ff2de01630d8eede9d.jpg[/img]
[h3]Release Live Stream[/h3]
Don't forget about our special Release Live Stream which is going to start today at 4 pm CEST. We will introduce some special guests, including Pavel, who will tell you more about this new map expansion while we haul cargo in Missouri. Towards the end of the live stream, we will officially release the Missouri DLC together, so make sure to be there!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/430a9075880d983ac0ed4cb1698c9c6f951b929f.jpg[/img]
[h3]Cruising Missouri Event[/h3]
Right with the release of this map expansion, we are also introducing the #CruisingMissouri World of Trucks Event in which you can participate! We challenge our #BestCommunityEver to achieve a collective goal of driving 125,000,000 miles while delivering cargo to or from any city in Missouri. The personal goal is to deliver cargo to or from all 12 cities in the Show Me State, with each job being 100 miles or more. You can read more about the event [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2025/04/cruising-missouri-world-of-trucks-event.html]here[/url].

Unique rewards await those who accomplish this feat! Truckers who complete their personal goal will be awarded the Beast of Burden ATS truck paint job.

notes.title: American Truck Simulator - 1.54 Update Release
notes.notes:
We are excited to share with our community that the 1.54 update for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/]American Truck Simulator[/url] is now officially released! This update features implementations, fixes, quality of life improvements and more. Let's dive in and take a look at what's in store.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/0f3143a8ab72d8299d0834902367e671c002a115.jpg[/img]

Before that, we have to give a huge shoutout to everyone who participated in the Open Beta phase, shared feedback, and reported bugs. Your invaluable contributions have allowed us to fine-tune content and eliminate bugs that slipped through the cracks initially. We hope that you will enjoy the new features, changes, and more that come with this update.

[h3][b]Cargo System Redefined[/b][/h3]

Until now, what seemed like the game combining a trailer with cargo, such as a piece of machinery, was actually a manually created model, with each trailer-cargo pair stored separately on disk. This approach required an enormous number of unique models, making it harder to add new content efficiently and taking up disk space.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/b80fd191de98cf2340cb777868ee317ea793d279.jpg[/img]
In the redefined cargo system, the code automatically merges cargo and trailers based on simplified rules. This means that each cargo will define its own model, loading methodology, and lashing method. This will make the work of our vehicle team much easier as it no longer requires our 3D artists to manually create pre-baked trailer-cargo pairs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/54e297da8beb9a32ccba0d6dc1c093fc230f0517.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/ab2adb21c0bf059c6f5cbbc182941389c9ebf831.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/696560cf7577bdb531f7ec958d721668c445509e.jpg[/img]
While there may be issues in the first iteration, it's a worthwhile goal to refine the system, as it not only improves efficiency but also saves disk space and memory by eliminating the need to store countless pre-made combinations. This project may also lead to other possibilities for both of our games, especially with dynamic cargo (un)loading and more. You can read about how this project was executed in our recent [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2025/02/under-hood-cargo-system-redefined.html]Under the Hood blog[/url].

[h3][b]Truck Adjustment Menu Redesign[/b][/h3]

The Truck Adjustment Menu has been completely redesigned to provide a more user-friendly experience. Previously, each option for adjusting your driver's FOV, seat, mirrors etc had separate menus with different layouts. Now, they share a cohesive interface, making adjustments much more intuitive and easier. The new design also takes on a similar design from our previous UI overhaul and is optimized for both mouse and controller, ensuring accessibility for all users.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/34f0bb8be0dd3fcdd5f09164d24159aa3a37b83e.jpg[/img]
For keyboard and mouse users, adjustments are now more streamlined with the use of the WASD keys for navigation, along with buttons for finer tuning. Meanwhile, controller users will find the new system much smoother, with the left stick controlling adjustments, the right stick handling camera movement for mirror positioning, and the D-pad or shoulder buttons navigating the menu.

The addition of shoulder button support makes menu navigation more fluid for controller players. This update makes adjusting mirrors and seats much easier, particularly for those using controllers, ensuring a more seamless and enjoyable driving experience. Accessing the Truck Adjustment Menu remains the same. You can use the F4 by default, a custom assigned key of your choice, or through the adviser services menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e27cab65d67c9bc49bc787c6701ace573fdf7884.jpg[/img]
We hope you enjoy this redesign, and that you find it easy to use and navigate through whilst you are out hauling on the road!

[h3][b]PhysX System Implementation[/b][/h3]

In 1.54, we are adopting the NVIDIA PhysX physics engine as an alternative to the current Bullet physics engine for low-level simulation of physics in the game world that players interact with. This shift allows players to experience more precise collision detection results and more robust behaviour during scenarios involving collisions between vehicles and obstacles or other vehicles. PhysX also offers our teams better debugging tools, which indirectly benefits players by helping resolve bugs more efficiently.

One of the most noticeable improvements brought by PhysX can already be experienced in our recently introduced Driving Academy game mode. For example, collisions with cones and obstacles are now more accurate and objects no longer appear to "levitate" slightly above the ground after interaction, a flaw that occurred with Bullet. While players may not see drastic changes, certain interactions should exhibit slightly improved behaviour.

During the Open Beta, many players expressed concerns about hardware limitations due to recent news that 32-bit version of PhysX would no longer be supported by certain GPUs. However, the PhysX implementation we use runs entirely on the CPU, meaning players can enjoy PhysX without worrying about graphics card compatibility.

With the release of version 1.54, PhysX is now the default physics engine for all gameplay. Players who prefer the previous Bullet physics engine can switch back by using the "-bullet" command line argument in their Steam launch options.

[h3][b]Driving Academy Rewards[/b][/h3]

Everyone who has already completed or will complete the entire first module of Driving Academy will receive special rewards to use inside the game on the same profile they completed the academy with - a hanging blue traffic cone cabin accessory and a customizable Driving Academy paint job for your truck. So make sure to complete your scenarios and grab your rewards, there will be more to come! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/7e65681deb713b0c4b8e45eafcf182d0c4fa8092.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/832bd36091d4e880ec54b6401b32a2be74e0e2d1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/bff4cefbb79f8f1307f7f61bfc2f242b802c8326.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Changelog[/b][/h3]

[h3][b]Gameplay[/b][/h3]

[*] Cargo System Redefined
[*] Driving Academy Rewards
[/list][h3][b]Visual[/b][/h3][list]
[*] Truck Adjustment Menu Redesign
[*] First Launch Screen Flow Refresh
[/list]
[h3][b]Vehicles[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Lode King & Prestige Trailers Pack bug fixes
[/list][h3][b]Other[/b][/h3]
[list][*] PhysX Implementation
[/list]
