notes.title: American Truck Simulator: 1.53 Update Release
notes.notes:
We are excited to reveal that the 1.53 Update for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/]American Truck Simulator[/url] is now released and available on Steam for you to enjoy! This free update contains some new content that you can read about below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/b6a45a7aabbd3e70db9f77e05e0ed72c38aad2be.jpg[/img]
We want to express our gratitude to everyone who took part in the Open Beta, shared their feedback, and reported bugs. Your contributions were invaluable in helping us fine-tune this update, implement improvements, and address issues that might have slipped through earlier. Thanks to your efforts, we hope you can now fully enjoy the results of your hard work!

[previewyoutube=S2Cp0okGuCU;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]California Rework - Phase 4[/h3]

Phase 4 of the California Rework project focused on the southern region of California and includes 10 cities, 3 of which are entirely new to the world of American Truck Simulator. Drivers working in this region can make deliveries to and from the cities of Bakersfield, [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2024/07/california-rework-santa-maria-oxnard.html]Santa Maria[/url], [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2024/07/california-rework-santa-maria-oxnard.html]Oxnard[/url], Mojave, Barstow, Indio, Blythe, [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2024/10/153-california-rework-los-angeles-san.html]Los Angeles[/url], [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2024/10/153-california-rework-los-angeles-san.html]San Diego[/url], and El Centro. Similar to previous phases, much of the original base map was removed and reworked entirely from the ground up including the cities' surrounding areas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/ebf1841657367fe584eb563f3fa1276f8ac16712.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/8c167a72d778d75ddeb8cc613b478d71875cc69a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/07736b2052b2af16823677a05e1f4ca88d3be7d0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/6214aec327b7e5b13e04e85906c9e4d8ebb13f5c.jpg[/img]
Our team also focused on reworking key routes, including major coastal highways such as the US-101, CA-1, and I-5. In addition, several other important routes have been revamped, such as the CA-58, CA-14, and CA-99, along with interstates I-10, I-15, I-40, and I-8, which serve as vital connections to neighboring U.S. states. You can read about this phase of the rework project in more detail in a [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2024/10/153-california-rework-phase-4.html]dedicated blog post[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/95a5f25095ecc238f09fb8756b0bbf4bb28d0837.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/ccb227429046c4e0afe519c17ba41759d2bd2824.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/586799ada0e984dd81cfd8a308506f1c4674ca80.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/6a4842c94e688a4a8b5fbcad226dc9a1781a1fa9.jpg[/img]
[h3]Dynamic Cargo (Un)loading Update[/h3]

Since the 1.50 update, we have implemented and then further expanded the dynamic cargo loading and unloading feature. So far, truckers have been able to experience this feature when hauling a grain hopper, a chip van, or a bolster logger. When using the logger, truckers were able to transport logs and enjoy the animated loading and unloading only in Arkansas. With the 1.53 update, this feature is available throughout the whole USA!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/256d4ce6aa906e1c404d40e440b3958648915072.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/46dd7107d44e4e974abce6b7a1e91022b2adbf43.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/da9b137486b87fb0308edd76cfcda71b967057f9.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/d527c00ab4e5c1ef8ab33bc7f94b072bcf783e81.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/ae0915b479c89c059ba85d38944c026d0d0749c8.jpg[/img]
[h3]Driving Academy Fifth Generation Cascadia[/h3]

In the 1.53 update, [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2024/10/ats-introducing-fifth-generation.html]The Fifth Generation Cascadia from Freightliner[/url] was implemented into [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2024/10/driving-academy-release.html]Driving Academy[/url], our brand new game module introduced in 1.52. This state-of-the-art truck is the newest addition to the ATS truck roster, and now you can try it out in various challenging scenarios in Driving Academy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/7ab78d7b4d33a3d2b8420f0a06d7eb8c5939d98f.jpg[/img]
[h3]Options QoL improvement[/h3]

We're happy to introduce a feature that we believe many players will find helpful, especially those who often adjust their settings to fine-tune what is best to their liking and setup. When changing an option with a default value, players now have a visual indication of when a setting has been moved or changed from its default state.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/79b81b443d94543cf4c7a73cf745c0186a010f71.jpg[/img]
Settings that have been adjusted from their default value now appear with a small visual indicator alongside that setting. We hope this helps users find which settings have been altered from default.

[h3]Smooth and Auto Camera Centring[/h3]

Another new feature that we are happy to include with this update is Smooth and Auto Camera Centering! Players can enable this new option to return their camera to the central position automatically after moving it. When activated by the player or by moving forward, the smooth centering feature becomes noticeable as it gently transitions the camera to the central position.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/3b7599653e44786dec5722e35cb38d8dce58f5e8.jpg[/img]
This addition comes with a range of personal preference options, including three options for speed, which controls how fast or slow the camera returns to the center; as well as the option to set how many seconds of delay there should be before re-centering occurs.

For players who use a third-party head-tracking solution or prefer to adjust the position of the camera manually, there is the option to disable this feature altogether.

[h3]Special Transport Update[/h3]

We have also updated the Special Transport DLC. As part of the California Rework project, we have added a new route for truckers to haul oversized cargo - between the rebuilt cities of Los Angeles and San Diego via the I-5.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/2585d8e7e662f5259333dd1e7287289e4e3785d6.jpg[/img]
But that's not all. In response to community feedback, we've decided to raise the maximum speed limit for special transport deliveries. Escort vehicles and transport trucks themselves can now travel at speeds of up to 55 mph, an increase from the previous limit of 40 mph.

[h3]Sliding Tandems Update[/h3]

We have also introduced a new sliding tandems feature. Previously, players could only set trailer axles in a fixed forward or rear position. Now, select trailers come with updated chassis, allowing players to slide the axles freely to optimize the weight distribution for their load.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/20423853d8999156338ec171238f41bc90cbad7f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/089acce4ebd8d631531cec888294d70ffcc0f462.jpg[/img]
But be cautious! To make this feature as realistic as possible, if the trailer's rear axle's distance exceeds 40 feet from the kingpin, you risk receiving a fine at Californian weigh stations and, in some cases, directly from the police.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/74a654cae8049653fb6f91feeebd66acdb422b72.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/c1f75762654863e790f99d084bd817f7b92f6b9a.jpg[/img]
[h3]Changelog[/h3]

[b]Map[/b]
[list]
[*] California Rework - Phase 4 release
[/list]
[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*] Dynamic cargo loading & unloading of logs available throughout the USA
[*] New Special Transport route from Los Angeles to San Diego
[*] Raised speed limit for Special Transport jobs from 40 mph to 55 mph
[/list]
[b]Vehicles[/b]
[list]
[*] The new Fifth Generation Freightliner Cascadia® added to Driving Academy
[*] Fully functional sliding tandems and fines system
[/list]
[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*] Visualization of changed options in the settings
[*] Smooth and Auto camera centering
[/list]
We hope you are excited about the new content! Remember to follow us on our social media ([url=https://twitter.com/SCSsoftware]X/Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/eurotrucksimulator2]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@scssoftware]TikTok[/url]) so you won't miss out on any news from the world of American Truck Simulator, and share screenshots and videos with us featuring new content. Drive safe!

notes.title: Pinktober 2024 Update
notes.notes:
With October already behind us, we wanted to share with you an update on our Pinktober 2024 campaign. Since 2019, we are proud to have continued to raise awareness and support for this important topic. If you missed our previous blog post all about this special month, we recommend that you [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2024/10/pinktober-2024.html]read about it here. [/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/a0bdf0c2f63a29bd4fd196bdb0f0b6cff8308223.jpg[/img]
First off, we'd like to extend a heartfelt thank you to our community for actively supporting Pinktober. Whether that be through sharing #Pinktober screenshots, tuning into our live streams or hosting your own charity convoys, these seemingly small gestures play an important role in the fight against this widespread disease. 

We'd also like to thank you, our #BestCommunityEver, who have helped us raise donations through the sales of our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1068290/Euro_Truck_Simulator_2__Pink_Ribbon_Charity_Pack/]Pink Ribbon Charity Packs for Euro Truck Simulator 2[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1162160/American_Truck_Simulator__Pink_Ribbon_Charity_Pack/]American Truck Simulator[/url]. We're happy to share that the amount raised from this year's sales of this special Paint Job Pack is a staggering 54,000 USD! This sum is truly remarkable, and we extend our gratitude to each and every one of you. We believe that contributing the entire amount to the Alliance of Women with Breast Cancer will make a significant difference in supporting those who need it most.

notes.title: American Truck Simulator - 1.53 Update: Open Beta
notes.notes:
Today, we are happy to share with you that the 1.53 Open Beta branch for American Truck Simulator is now available to try and test out. If you plan on participating in this Open Beta, we ask that you please help us by reporting any bugs you may encounter in the [url=https://forum.scssoft.com/viewforum.php?f=330]appropriate section(s) of our official forums[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/e8bf6fb9213dc0f0b730c6aa92b0d93cbc19406e.jpg[/img]
Your feedback and reports are extremely valuable to our team and we thank you in advance for taking the time to help us out. So, without further ado, let's take a look at what the 1.53 Open Beta has in store.

[h3]California Rework - Phase 4[/h3]

Phase 4 of the California Rework project focuses on the southern region of California and includes 10 cities, 3 of which are entirely new to the world of American Truck Simulator. Drivers working in this region can look forward to making deliveries to and from the cities of Bakersfield, [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2024/07/california-rework-santa-maria-oxnard.html]Santa Maria[/url], [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2024/07/california-rework-santa-maria-oxnard.html]Oxnard[/url], Mojave, Barstow, Indio, Blythe, [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2024/10/153-california-rework-los-angeles-san.html]Los Angeles[/url], [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2024/10/153-california-rework-los-angeles-san.html]San Diego[/url], and El Centro. Similar to previous phases, much of the original base map was removed and reworked entirely from the ground up including the cities' surrounding areas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/8b99e44b367951f966819a25a015ce11a2acaeed.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/faa3ee5dcde9b86fb1163ee3026f713204aa6893.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/4ab76d6861859a7dbf5917d9e9d033f912efe36f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/29518364b2cc03b204b4b0c38d0cae6ec0768199.jpg[/img]
Our team also focused on reworking key routes, including major coastal highways such as the US-101, CA-1, and I-5. In addition, several other important routes have been revamped, such as the CA-58, CA-14, and CA-99, along with interstates I-10, I-15, I-40, and I-8, which serve as vital connections to neighboring U.S. states. You can read about this phase of the rework project in more detail in a [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2024/10/153-california-rework-phase-4.html]dedicated blog post[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/8a5fbe5fcc6118c32fc3e7fe03c0290778109d15.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/5e42029323fee2cae9ce9cfc7a29690c9842bf2c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/96c034031e2ba29460a484de2589f256f5138cf5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/3fa1512364a2d06ccccba73cf2eebb7b2e144de6.jpg[/img]
[h3]Dynamic Cargo (Un)loading Update[/h3]

Since the 1.50 update, we have implemented and then further expanded the dynamic cargo loading and unloading feature. So far, truckers have been able to experience this feature when hauling a grain hopper, a chip van, or a bolster logger. When using the logger, truckers were able to transport logs and enjoy the animated loading and unloading only in Arkansas. With the 1.53 update, we are happy to share with you that this feature will be available throughout the whole USA!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/90d679ec629a48442ea89267a13387ec806959de.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/ec475ee1d734c02329dc7d37bebb95d5387a5d31.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/7209303143c97909650521348ff3e30b14a3a843.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/727e61b4ab5f15c85e3141e0a1440302986efcbe.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/98a6e2dbb3fb16dfe9a3d800a84508a7b6cdef39.jpg[/img]
[h3]Driving Academy Fifth Generation Cascadia[/h3]

In the 1.53 update, [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2024/10/ats-introducing-fifth-generation.html]The Fifth Generation Cascadia from Freightliner[/url] will be implemented into [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2024/10/driving-academy-release.html]Driving Academy[/url], our brand new game module introduced in 1.52. This state-of-the-art truck is the newest addition to the ATS truck roster, and now you will have the option to try it out in various challenging scenarios in Driving Academy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/3f5082838e8381bf16744061927ce23e12b5ea01.jpg[/img]
[h3]Options QoL improvement[/h3]

We're happy to introduce a feature that we believe many players will find helpful, especially those who often adjust their settings to fine-tune what is best to their liking and setup. When changing an option with a default value, players will now have a visual indication of when a setting has been moved or changed from its default state. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/341b26bf660fe0d3711229eb8bde13f734f4e277.jpg[/img]
Settings that have been adjusted from their default value will now appear with a small visual indicator alongside that setting. We hope this helps users find which settings have been altered from default.

[h3]Smooth and Auto Camera Centering[/h3]
Another new feature that we are happy to include with this update is Smooth and Auto Camera Centring! Players can now enable this new option to return their camera to the central position automatically after moving it. When activated by the player or by moving forward, the smooth centering feature becomes noticeable as it gently transitions the camera to the central position.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/6d667dffe53f7bcac02f6a0d66d1c49c4bd8af84.jpg[/img]
This addition comes with a range of personal preference options, including three options of speed, which controls how fast or slow the camera returns to the center; as well as the option to set how many seconds of delay there should be before re-centring occurs.

For players who use a third-party head-tracking solution or prefer to adjust the position of the camera manually, also have the option to disable this feature altogether.

[h3]Special Transport Update[/h3]

We are also updating the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/962750/American_Truck_Simulator__Special_Transport/]Special Transport DLC[/url]. As part of the California Rework project, we have added a new route for truckers to haul oversized cargo - between the rebuilt cities of Los Angeles and San Diego via I-5 route.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/8461606a8878208da1d6fd81de769b68d9123351.jpg[/img]
But that's not all. In response to community feedback, we've decided to raise the maximum speed limit for special transport deliveries. Escort vehicles and the transport trucks themselves can now travel at speeds of up to 55 mph, an increase from the previous limit of 40 mph. We would like to ask our players to try out this update and share feedback on whether it enhances immersion and improves the overall smoothness of these jobs.

[h3]Sliding Tandems Update[/h3]

In the 1.53 update, we're also introducing a new sliding tandems feature. Previously, players could only set trailer axles in a fixed forward or rear position. Now, select trailers come with updated chassis, allowing players to slide the axles freely to optimize the weight distribution for their load.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/d50e3043927fb1e91138b5ef72e62eaced0fbc1c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/ca455c16ab2aacd4700c2ff0a1f7d29750e4f643.jpg[/img]
But be cautious! To make this feature as realistic as possible, if the trailer's rear axle's distance exceeds 40 feet from the kingpin, you risk receiving a fine at California weigh stations and, in some cases, directly from the police.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/1fc8cb4c3506f70491f19d0c6fa6c6eba8eb5e15.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/4efc5cb5226190343d2f215388e3ae4b6eedd191.jpg[/img]
[h3]Changelog [/h3]

[b]Map[/b]
[list]
[*] California Rework - Phase 4 release
[/list]
[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*] Dynamic cargo loading & unloading of logs available throughout the USA
[*] New Special Transport route from Los Angeles to San Diego
[*] Raised speed limit for Special Transport jobs from 40 mph to 55 mph
[/list]
[b]Vehicles[/b]
[list]
[*] The new Fifth Generation Freightliner Cascadia® added to Driving Academy
[*] Fully functional sliding tandems and fines system
[/list]
[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*] Visualization of changed options in the settings
[*] Smooth and Auto camera centering
[/list]
So enjoy all the new additions, but please remember: It's only an open beta, not a stable public version - so you may encounter bugs, instability, or crashes. It's completely okay if you want to wait for the final release. But if you're interested in helping us to get there faster, we'll appreciate all of your feedback on our forum and your bug reports [url=https://forum.scssoft.com/viewforum.php?f=330]in this section[/url].

Please check our modding wiki to get details pertaining to mods for the game.

If you wish to participate in the open beta, you can find this version in the public_beta branch on Steam. The way to access it is as follows: Steam client → LIBRARY → right-click on American Truck Simulator  → Properties → Betas tab → public_beta → 1.53. No password is required. Sometimes you may have to restart your Steam client to see the correct branch name there.

notes.title: Driving Academy Release
notes.notes:
Today, we are very happy to announce that Driving Academy is now available for American Truck Simulator! A few weeks ago, we announced this new game module in [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2024/09/152-update-driving-academy.html]this blog[/url] and showed you a preview of it in some of our [url=https://www.youtube.com/@SCSSoftware/streams]live streams[/url], and now you can finally try it out for yourself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/1cfe871d0f77b58dadbbdc4125669b3efa6eefa8.jpg[/img]
As was mentioned in the previous blog we released about Driving Academy, we are venturing into new territory, inspired by years of feedback from players who have told us that our games have helped them grasp the basics of truck driving. Many have used it to get a sense of handling a truck and trailer, learning how to maneuver and reverse. With this in mind, we thought we'd take it a step further with this free update which includes sets of scenarios designed to improve and expand these skills in a fun and captivating way. 

We've prepared a short video just for you, explaining everything you need to know about Driving Academy. It also includes a brief yet comprehensive guide on how to get started and make the most out of the game module.

[previewyoutube=fav9uncyvYA;full][/previewyoutube]
This new game module will provide you with various scenarios of increasing difficulty inspired by instructions given to real-life students. You will go from basic driving to navigating intricate courses and complex parking maneuvers with a detailed explanation via driving instructions including diagrams, pointers, and directions. notes.title: Star Nation Experience 2024 Update
notes.notes:
Earlier this year, we announced that we have teamed up with Western Star Trucks for the [url=https://www.westernstartrucks.com/star-nation/]Star Nation Experience 2024[/url] in [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2024/03/star-nation-experience-2024.html]this blog[/url]. Along with us, [url=https://www.westernstartrucks.com/]Western Star Trucks[/url], and members of the Star Nation community, two lucky [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/]American Truck Simulator[/url] players had the chance to win an all-expenses-paid trip to Bend, Oregon, and take part in this unforgettable once-in-a-lifetime experience.

Unfortunately, the original date for the Star Nation Experience 2024 had to be cancelled due to the wildfires spreading in the area. As a result, Western Star, in cooperation with local authorities, firefighters, and sheriffs, made the decision to postpone the event to ensure everyone's safety. The new date has now been announced: the event will take place from September 27 to September 30! And today, we are excited to introduce the two participants from our ATS community, so let's meet them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/d0439e7820fe05e4fbd64d671f487ec8497f6d56.jpg[/img]
But first, we shall remind you of what this amazing event is all about. In the heart of Oregon's untamed wilderness, Western Star Trucks hosted the first Star Nation Experience last year for eight lucky winners of their raffle, marking the first of its kind in the trucking industry. 

It is a wild, adrenaline-fueled experience filled with trucking, fly fishing, ATV fun, and more adventures celebrating everything that makes Western Star and the Star Nation community special. The highlight of the event is undoubtedly the behind-the-scenes tour of Daimler's High Desert Proving Grounds in Madras, where they took on the ultimate driver challenge last year, pushing Western Star X-Series trucks to their limits. And this year will be no different.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/732949fa3876669db8d985c963661ff7143accba.png[/img]
As we already mentioned above, for the Star Nation Experience 2024, Western Star has invited us to participate but also dedicated two slots of the team of eight lucky winners to members of our American Truck Simulator community. Our friends at Western Star received plenty of applications and a few weeks ago, they selected the winners. We are very excited to meet with all of them, especially with the two from our community - Connor and Brendan.

[h3]Brendan[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/ee807b423802bf09aa81f35466afb67ec79e9667.jpg[/img]
Brendan's passion for trucking traces all the way back to his childhood. [i]"I’ve been obsessed ever since I was a kid. I would always play with toy trucks and pull wagons around in my yard,"[/i] he says. This early fascination grew into a full-blown obsession with trucks, leading him to discover the world of ATS and a career as a driver.

Since 2019, Brendan has been an avid player, drawn to the game's meticulous detail and immersive environments, which realistically replicated real trucking experiences. In ATS, Brendan's vehicle of choice is the Western Star 4900EX, inspired by his fond memories of riding in his father's truck as a child. Captivated by its iconic design and reliability, Brendan enthusiastically recreated his favorite truck in-game, using mods to enhance his virtual trucking adventures.

Outside of ATS, Brendan's dedication to trucking extends into his professional life, where he spends most of his time on the road, logging miles as a professional truck driver.

[h3]Connor[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/f7958e7b226efbf51087e846dfcfba4c230294b3.jpg[/img]
Connor’s passion for ATS began with the original Euro Truck Simulator when he was just 12 years old. [i]"There was something about the open road and the sounds of the truck engine that always pulled me into playing more,"[/i] Connor recalled.

In the virtual realm of ATS, Connor drives his favorite truck, the Western Star 57X, relishing its smooth rides and long-haul comfort. The truck's iconic logo holds a special place in Conor’s heart; it resonates with him - something he identifies with. Beyond gaming, Connor values ATS for its ability to offer a temporary escape from the humdrum of everyday life as well as the opportunity for him to immerse himself in the role of an owner-operator, participating in virtual convoys and engaging with a community of fellow trucking enthusiasts.

We would like to thank Western Star Truck for this wonderful opportunity to be a part of this adventure along with the members of our American Truck Simulator community. Keep a close eye on Western Star's [url=https://www.facebook.com/westernstartrucks]Facebook[/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/westernstartruck]Instagram[/url], and our [url=https://twitter.com/SCSsoftware]X/Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/@SCSSoftware/]YouTube[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/scssoft]Facebook[/url] so you don't miss out on any news from the Star Nation Experience 2024 which Nemiro and Mark will also attend. Get ready to embark on this unforgettable adventure with us!

notes.title: Arkansas DLC Release + Forest Machinery DLC Update
notes.notes:
Today is the day, engines at the ready! The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2585150/American_Truck_Simulator__Arkansas/]Arkansas DLC[/url] for American Truck Simulator releases today and we can't wait for you to get haulin'. Are you ready to explore the Natural State and all that it has to offer? Let's get cruising! 

[h3]The Arkansas DLC has been released and is now available on Steam![/h3]

[previewyoutube=PPJABNHzQdY;full][/previewyoutube]
We cannot wait for you to embark on your first journey into Arkansas. Our team has been working hard to ensure everything is running smoothly for its release. From bug smashing to putting in additional polish on the map, we're ready for you to explore and deliver across the State! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/aac709c6142d27ee9461943bf8feb623ad08bb63.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Take your time and enjoy every moment as you discover:
[*] 10 explorable cities including Little Rock, Fortsmith, Fayetteville and Pine Bluff.
[*] See several landmarks unique to Arkansas such as the historical centre of Hot Springs with its Bathhouse Row and National Park, iconic art murals, the majestic Arlington Hotel, courthouses, churches and more.
[*] Enjoy trucking through 10 scenic towns (settlements)
[*] Discover a variety of different viewpoints across Arkansas
[*] See the famous Arkansas and Mississippi rivers which run through the State.
[*] Drive across the impressively large Emmitt Sanders Lock and Dam, which has been in operation since December 1968!
[*] Deliver to unique industries such as the Nuclear One power plant, and custom built River Port & Timber Harvest depots. 
[*] Experience the new dynamic loading and unloading of logs onto your trailer.
[*] Discover the hidden treasures of Arkansas's countryside, forest, swampland, viewpoints, road network and more.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/0d9c0127a1f4d5493df7a7e3af9b4479b7447272.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/5e1d014edbc3ad0f538c9733fb8594f05a9c4058.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4c3cb801e0b8dc3cd048328ab49ca81b0db60e66.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/a4aca19dd6caac9ad8fc4964f4065ea9c7bf2c57.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/7a97da93e16398963d2323e457cc281431eca128.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/2368f954859f9a8a139cc20fe3269a3181c1b522.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/03438c9bd1cc94c4000ed04fc2ddd42b752ac337.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/82926f359eeb9efbedbe974b186fa06aabddacfd.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/7c04807de28c5c3c7624f3476077ceb6976dc5b5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/abe2987ed7e54592020d623a1ad6331a7f125a83.jpg[/img]
From cities large and small, Arkansas has something new to explore around every corner. From art murals, to swampland and the custom-made farms, grain elevators,  river ports and timber harvest depots, there is something for everyone to discover and enjoy. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/24ed4e5aec705ab386c5f0f78758a1a87dff3ac2.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/5d1444f46f5b5af651a250822dded6fbdbbd6f72.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/412723445cb1fefc14ef05f12f052f2db53b096a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/afb77bbebafa121c8c3c620524bbc8aef0de6f3a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/0c513d9a13aced61878cb2675813f5405c052733.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/6e56021a1cc134e11588f833c12ac72ec8f7241c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/2c46baaf430c7b9f222d0939cef93acdde1df3ab.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/68e46ba446b7e04734e569694f75b7e7ad9fa307.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/1b27c5823e844bf2ab876dfb66384467a310b229.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Forest Machinery DLC Update[/b][/h3]
We are also happy to share that the Forest Machinery DLC will be receiving a free update with the release of Arkansas. With its many forestry and logging related industries, these companies often require lots of heavy duty equipment and vehicles, one of which we are excited to bring as a new cargo in this DLC!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/3541f03d6babada59b0a8fa9d3c211595cc725da.jpg[/img]
Introducing the Forestry Skidder, a specialized machine used in logging operations to transport felled trees from the cutting site to a central location for processing or loading. It typically drags logs across the forest floor, either using a cable system or a grapple claw to secure the logs. Skidders are essential for efficiently moving timber, especially in rough or uneven terrain, and help streamline the process of harvesting trees in large-scale logging operations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/b8110c13344203afcc335b1603b49ce3fa340cc7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/46a734773dc9f3786fbd855d7cf29938eab0bf1f.jpg[/img]
That's not all however, as owners of this DLC will also be able to enjoy some cabin accessories from our in-game brand 'OWL' for their truck cab! Including protective Ear Muffs, a mug and a road-sign themed hanging cabin item! We hope DLC owners enjoy hauling this heavy duty machine across Arkansas and beyond with this free update.

[h3][b]Arkan-saw Bundle[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/80248810b77d79a0e8dcfbffa61c2fe65291b063.jpg[/img]
If both the Arkansas DLC and the new Forest Machinery content takes your interest, consider purchasing our newest [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/45098/Arkansaw_Bundle/]Arkan-saw bundle[/url] (get it?) which includes both the Arkansas DLC and the Forest Machinery DLC at a discounted price! It is the perfect bundle for truckers looking to get the fullest experience out of the Natural State.

This bundle operates on a "Complete the set" basis, ensuring you only pay for the DLCs that are not already in your library. Happy travels! 

[h3][b]Release Live Stream![/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/cd1236c1c5c87d92351135826b61b7cb010ff78c.jpg[/img]

Can't wait to get trucking? Join Mark & Petr for the Arkansas DLC Release Live Stream! Also featured are special guests involved in the development of this new expansion. Don't miss out, tune in at our official Twitch or YouTube channels today from 4:00 PM CEST onwards. 

[h3][b]Cruising Arkansas Event[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/177a4e24b887bb4578ac24462b9d4b8ebcb9b77b.jpg[/img]

Excited to get driving? Don't forget, you can also join in on the #CruisingArkansas World of Trucks event, where you can earn unique in-game Arkansas themed rewards!  We are asking you, our #BestCommunityEver to help contribute and complete the community goal of driving 125,000,000 miles (201,168,000 km) while delivering cargo to or from any city in Arkansas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/298008204867df9f3eca42285fa0feb5aa3d37fc.jpg[/img]
Players who achieve their personal goal of delivering to or from 10 Arkansas cities will receive a lovely White-tailed Watch ATS truck paint job. If the community goal is reached, all players who have completed their personal goal will also receive a hanging Diamond Apple Blossom pendant for their cabin! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c506ef1de04ee976fee811d1bca8bf13a0159434.jpg[/img]
But that's not all! We also have another unique gift for you. If you take any External Contract or External Market job TO or FROM the city of Pine Bluff, you'll earn this adorable fluffy White-tailed Deer fawn plush for their truck cabin. We think it makes for the perfect mascot whilst trucking through the Natural state! 

If you'd like to learn more about this event, check out the dedicated blog here.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/5101c71d3695f31a30aba3547be0dc78d2d31231.jpg[/img]
We hope you enjoy cruising and discovering Arkansas! We cannot thank you enough for all your support leading upto to the release of this DLC. Our team would love to hear what you think of Arkansas, if you enjoyed it, please consider leaving a review on Steam! Until next time, keep on truckin'!

notes.title: Mack Pinnacle & Mack Anthem Black Edition Release
notes.notes:
We're thrilled to announce the arrival of the legendary Mack® Pinnacle in American Truck Simulator, which is now available to purchase and drive in-game. However, that's not all—we're also excited to introduce the Limited Edition Mack Black Anthem® too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/288ea1d21c45a69e06a5a8e8c71af0fad454338b.jpg[/img]
Ready to get trucking? Let's take a closer look at these new additions! 

[h3][b]Mack Pinnacle [/b][/h3]
The Mack Pinnacle™ combines power and reliability with modern technology and a classic design. The result is a legendary workhorse, ready to take on any job while making every drop of fuel count. The Pinnacle’s lightweight-yet-strong frame is built for heavy loads, steep grades and long hauls, making it the perfect choice for your next journey in American Truck Simulator.

[previewyoutube=bD9EkT6vQIo;full][/previewyoutube]
The Pinnacle's virtual implementation includes an array of configurations options including 3 cabin variants (Day Cab, 48-inch Flat Top Sleeper and 70-inch StandUp Sleeper), several chassis and length options (6x2, 6x2 Liftable Pusher and 6x4), 3 engine options ranging from 415hp to 505hp, and a choice of numerous transmissions are available. New with the addition of the Pinnacle is the Mack mDrive­™ HD transmission, equipped with crawler gears to help get any load moving. It's complimented by a low final drive ratio to keep engine RPMs low at highway speeds to help maximize efficiency.

notes.title: American Truck Simulator 1.51 Update Release
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce that the 1.51 update for American Truck Simulator has been released and is now available on Steam. This update contains bug fixes, changes and new content, which are featured below, so we recommend having a read! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/22e0ffee551560c799a3a55533ed5f197eb662da.jpg[/img]

We'd like to take this opportunity to thank everyone who participated, provided their feedback, and made bug reports during the Open Beta period. Your valuable input helped us make tweaks, changes and squash some bugs that we may have missed the first time around. We hope you can now begin to fully enjoy the fruits of your work.

[previewyoutube=jnbtrkVXbGM;full][/previewyoutube]
[b][h3]New Title Screen[/h3][/b]
One of the first and most prominent changes you will encounter in this update is a complete redesign of our Title Screen. Whilst keeping in line with our recent user interface rework, we wanted a design which is easy to navigate and understand for all players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/046d0509d394542d7172df68b15ac24378d48632.jpg[/img]
First and foremost, one of the main difference you'll notice about the new Title Screen is the focus on a truck in the centre of the screen. On the left, you'll find the menu which allows easy access to the more important features of the game, such as Options, and other sub-menus such as the DLC (formerly DLC Browser) and the Mod Manager, which will display the number of MODs active next to it if you have any installed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/d745f1f1a4c193413cc48e45474d8fd9ecd982a2.jpg[/img]
To access your Profile Manager, just simply click your profile widget located in the top right of the menu screen. 

Functionally, we have also made navigation more comfortable with a gamepad or a steering wheel, requiring less time reaching for a keyboard from the moment you launch ETS2 or ATS. This design also leaves us space to make tweaks and changes where needed, as well as make additions in the future.

[b][h3]Mack Black Anthem[/h3][/b]
The Mack Anthem just got a whole lot cooler! Introducing the Limited Edition Mack Black Anthem® in American Truck Simulator, featuring a blacked-out exterior trim package and other additional interior features. In developing this special truck, designers started with a 70-inch StandUp sleeper model painted Mack Black and spec’d it up with Mack’s black exterior trim package. They then added a number of unique styling features, including a bold black Mack wordmark across the grille.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/71507082b79227633baf3c5f67f35199d998cf57.jpg[/img]
The cab steps and deck plates are also powder-coated in black, and flat black trim stripes are added to the air intakes on each side of the hood. Black mudflap brackets, black fuel tanks, black style aluminium wheels and a limited edition Anthem doorplate add to the distinctive look. Completing the exterior transformation of the Mack Black Anthem is a unique black Mack Bulldog ornament on the hood.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c0754d223c5f364839615ea6798fff0411d0e0eb.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/55f7a940e1bc0a9a7adc5f325dd4c2f94e0a1436.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/d3cd852dc20829b5ee9aea7683f2135a416adfa0.jpg[/img]
It looks business, and it means business! Whilst limited to only 500 made in the real world, The Mack Black Anthem® is available to purchase at your nearest in-game Mack Trucks dealer for all owners of American Truck Simulator. We hope you enjoy this awesome looking variant of an already legendary truck. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/fa165483990bba035fdc7a6a940bf5a1db55cc5f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/a09f2c19357829321c8678558b59a0de25e86231.jpg[/img]
A big thank you goes out to the team at Mack Trucks, for allowing us to bring this awesome-looking addition to American Truck Simulator as part of the 1.51 update, and for assisting our team in creating it. We hope you enjoy driving The Mack Black Anthem® across the States, and we look forward to seeing your screenshots and more on our social media channels.

[i]The MACK trademarks and designs are registered rights of the AB Volvo Group and are used pursuant to a license.[/i]

[b][h3]Dynamic Cargo (Un)Loading of Grain Hoppers & Chip vans[/h3][/b]
In the 1.50 update, we introduced a dynamic loading and unloading feature for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2543810/American_Truck_Simulator__Nebraska/]Nebraska DLC's[/url] custom agriculture depots using a grain hopper trailer. Now, we are happy to reveal that in the 1.51 update for American Truck Simulator, we are going to add more animated loading options as well as depots where players will encounter this feature!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/6153cbfe1400b161dc45395c783ed8dcc5c510b3.jpg[/img]
Truckers delivering with their own grain hopper trailer will experience dynamic loading and unloading when transporting corn, soybean, grain, sugar beet, pelleted animal food, potatoes, or cotton seed not only in Nebraska but also in custom depots found in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2298430/American_Truck_Simulator__Kansas/]Kansas DLC,[/url] the upcoming Arkansas DLC, and in "prefab" depots across American Truck Simulator.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/a02f655a930188617cabd27ea3a771e18ab30d6f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/263178f19518003e1c2e2ee4a09f7627299b5953.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c759a5e6e1a6eac4d7fddd02231c1acc937e00b4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/9e43d12d40f9857c66113f46b28a87364bef2b21.jpg[/img]
But that is not all! This upcoming update will also include a new dynamic loading option for the chip van when hauling wood shavings or cotton seeds. Currently, this dynamic feature is available only for cargo loading and will appear in Arkansas' custom depots as well as "prefab" depots across the USA. We plan to extend this functionality to include other types of cargo haulable with a chip van as well as dynamic unloading in the future.

You can read more about this feature in a [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2024/08/151-update-grain-hoppers-chip-vans.html]blogpost[/url] we posted.

[b][h3]I-44 and more for Oklahoma DLC[/h3][/b]
The missing link along the I-44 has been frequently requested by our community, so we are glad to be able to bring this new content as part of the upcoming 1.51 update for ATS. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/6c9e5d0cf0b63c5e570a9f5c8ff2e458b19f91a1.jpg[/img]
Currently in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2209650/American_Truck_Simulator__Oklahoma/]Oklahoma DLC[/url], the middle section of Interstate 44 through Oklahoma City is missing. However in the 1.51 update, we are happy to be able to bring this section in, connecting the western and eastern sections and completing I-44 in Oklahoma. This will of course come as a free update to all current owners of the Oklahoma DLC. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/db210daec4200d4e363942e2e83521ad1608f25e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/0c58fb9430425ea34a2c407e33e1ac9612484646.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/3e335b5f4dc687ec18720495146f0ff726c7d5d5.jpg[/img]
That is not all however, the I-44 will also include two new depots for players to deliver to and from; a furniture store and a construction site. Along with this addition, players will also be treated to 2 new truck stops on the I-40. If you'd like to read more about these changes, check out the [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2024/07/ats-151-update-i-44-and-more-in.html]dedicated blog on this topic here.
[/url]
[b][h3]Vegetation Update for Texas DLC[/h3][/b]
In collaboration with our vegetation department, our map designers have replaced the older pines with the more accurate loblolly pines native to Texas! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/01b4bcc49478f5c9d6e08c394363c0397bb7876f.jpg[/img]
The loblolly pines were initially created for the Arkansas DLC but also naturally grow in Texas. To enhance realism and ensure a smoother transition when driving between these states, truckers will now encounter an abundance of these trees throughout the entire eastern part of Texas - along roads, in forests, and within towns.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/7654466121cf06ebfc5027ccc9fcc88571e9216c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/1dcf4712e6652050b28d48ddba28a658895bea51.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/91c64fc459e4db1e289918b05dacfaf46438a8b1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/fc0e8c05ae5971327d6207acb28ada6fcb4c366e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e1f90fb9d312dcaa3f53c05f9694bdf5b0306d47.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/865c8199d53426b031bfd8e1ec11b98d3417c19f.jpg[/img]
We hope you will appreciate our teams' attention to detail, going back to previously released map expansions and updating them based on your feedback to correct any imperfections.

[b][h3]Custom City Intros for Oregon DLC[/h3][/b]
We are happy to share that we have now expanded Custom City Intros to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/800370/American_Truck_Simulator__Oregon/]Oregon DLC[/url] for American Truck Simulator! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/adefa9b9d79b4faa3240f20c80bb3bf264216e9b.png[/img]
These special cutscenes appear when a player selects a starting city when creating a new profile. We hope that new players (or those restarting a new profile) will enjoy these new additions, showcasing the area where you have chosen to begin.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c11df0cb141954b1ae0cbfdb31bd3b9d4522954e.png[/img]
We hope you enjoy this addition, and we look forward to introducing it to more states in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/9db3b624059d37ff325a447681e9bc4066701a4e.jpg[/img]
[b][h3]FlowBelow Update for Various Trucks[/h3][/b] 
We've teamed up with FlowBelow to extend the possibilities of having the FlowBelow Tractor AeroKit™ installed on a number of trucks in American Truck Simulator. Players will now have the choice of having FlowBelow fairings and wheel covers on the following vehicles: 
[list][*] Kenworth T680
[*] Peterbilt 579
[*] Volvo VNL
[*] Mack Anthem
[*] Freightliner Cascadia
[*] Western Star 5700XE and 57X[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/bc853cb829f6377cf66936cf0529efc00cb1d99f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/d85d2468a4686da8a7c29606217bd09a5de47ff2.jpg[/img]
In the real world, the FlowBelow Tractor AeroKit™ delivers fuel savings for drivers on the road, and can be found installed on thousands of trucks across the United States. For players in American Truck Simulator, we're happy to bring this economical solution to your virtual fleet. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/982ac7daf35d82df9983f4e27d1c15ea3f9043a6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/3a2d8f63ab8d28833e3d7ba93a015a3bb64b9459.jpg[/img]
It also has the added benefit of minimizing turbulence and improving aerodynamics by surrounding the drive wheels to better manage the air that moves around the tractor while in motion. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4a9095eb0ccac31fac006ab9c1bb98e2436a34aa.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/825774b6d9686522c32d3bb42ad00097429e1fe2.jpg[/img]
We hope that you enjoy using FlowBelow on your future journeys in American Truck Simulator, be sure to share pictures of your newly installed kit on our official social media channels. 

[b][h3]Truck Interior Shadows Improvement[/h3][/b]
We've also taken the time to create a more realistic visualisation of truck interior shadows through our new tool called Interior Shadow Tweaker. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/183a00a617bd8f0054b87d8032e1b707a829d70c.jpg[/img]
It allows us to create simplified cage around the cabin of the truck blocking incoming light, thus improving realism of the lighting reflected in the interior of the cabin. No more washed out materials of interior when you are passing another truck, lamp or police beacons.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/9f56c48c574cf54ef8e6882837ef0230e6130410.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/0332c2503bcb16691bfe432daadf993ac641e84f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/646e797445133a329d2a1b7ea9edb098d4b4ed29.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c6774e6fb22b470e29007b919d65186f4e4c24e5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/b47a0a25cb585ed5de200d557f0d65f3cb37b4e7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/dbf970e823380daaf5323cff0309e69f6cc0268b.jpg[/img]

We hope you enjoy this small but notable improvement to your trucking experience!

[b][h3]1.51 Update: New Controller Config[/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/b91f9026a582ebcca53793dac69d82445b836b87.jpg[/img]
We are enhancing the controller settings system, which will enable players to control the game with ease and offer them more flexibility and control. These changes will also pave the way for exciting future projects! Not only will you now be able to control more game features while using only your controller, but we also tried to set up the controls in a way that resembles driving a vehicle in real life which we hope will be natural and more immersive for you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e16e2e89ac508a0d2fd7777a659082940cce1dc0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/dd8b8f44bd96105cf0857a4bb574e0f64186e401.png[/img]
Although these changes will improve the controller settings and make it easier for players using controllers to engage with the game, there may be some cases where customized control settings could be affected. Unfortunately, players who have heavily modified their control layouts through the Steam controller configuration UI and shifted them from the default settings may see their custom configurations reset to default after the update.

Read more about this update at a [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2024/09/151-update-new-controller-config.html]recent blogpost.[/url]

[b][h3]Options QoL Improvements [/h3][/b]
The main change is the addition of a search bar for easier navigation across all settings categories. When a search is conducted, matches will be displayed in the current setting category, and sections where the search term also appears will be highlighted.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/314b0225f0c727c3202c5cdb3b98d89d909b3c76.jpg[/img]
We have also reorganized the existing options in the settings for better clarity. These options are now divided into subcategories within each section. Additionally, two new categories, "Interface" and "Accessibility," have been added to the bottom menu for better distribution.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/f551f94a7a076716a51406db771d483a373509f7.jpg[/img]
We've also introduced some changes that provide ease of access when it comes to changing the Desktop Background in ETS2 and ATS. You can now change your menu background directly using a shortcut from the main menu, or alternatively, you can access the same option via the interface section in your settings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/aabe38807fdfc4c528f45a7dffd3f7235bcecb82.jpg[/img]
However, that's not all! We've now also made it possible to preview your backgrounds before changing them. Simply click on the background of your choice via the carousel, and you'll be presented with a short preview of how it would look, before confirming your selection. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c0791cd47e5994ad45f8f475390fd71ee9d24acf.jpg[/img]
Players will also be notified through a small widget on the main menu if they have received a new Desktop Background option as part of an event reward or update. Clicking on this will also direct you to the new settings which are implemented in this update.

As a bonus to better desktop background visualization, we've also added a new background named 'Black light studio', we hope that you like it! Be sure to check it out.

[b][h3]Automatic Differential Lock + Blind Spot Sensor[/h3][/b]
We're also happy to introduce the option to enable and disable the Blind Spot Sensor and Automatic Differential Lock.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/fe0b1d6585c6bc6bbdc5e61c0895b2b1a8c59aca.jpg[/img]
The Automatic Differential Lock helps manage traction in difficult driving conditions by automatically engaging when needed. The Blind Spot Sensor provides visual and audible warnings to improve safety when changing lanes.

We hope you enjoy these features, which ultimately allows you to tailor your trucking simulation experience based on how you enjoy it!

[h3][b]Changelog [/b][/h3]

[h3][b]Map[/b][/h3][list]
[*] I-44 update for the Oklahoma DLC
[*] Vegetation update for the Texas DLC
[*] Custom City Intros for Oregon DLC[/list]
[h3][b]Gameplay[/b][/h3][list]
[*] Dynamic cargo (un)loading of grain hoppers & chip vans
[*] Automatic differential lock option
[*] Automatic blind spot sensor option[/list]
[h3][b]Vehicles[/b][/h3][list]
[*] FlowBelow update for various trucks
[*] Mack Black Anthem added[/list]
[h3][b]UI[/b][/h3][list]
[*] New Title Screen
[*] Search bar added to the settings menu
[*] Accessibility and Interface categories added to the settings menu
[*] Improved changing of desktop background
[*] New Controller Config[/list]
[h3][b]Visuals[/b][/h3][list]
[*] Enhanced interior cabin shadows in the truck cabin
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/

notes.title: American Truck Simulator: 1.51 Update Open Beta
notes.notes:
Today, we are happy to share with you that the 1.51 Open Beta branch for American Truck Simulator is now available to try and test out. If you plan on participating in this Open Beta, we ask that you please help us by reporting any bugs you may encounter in the [url=https://forum.scssoft.com/viewforum.php?f=330]appropriate section(s) of our official forums.[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/96499322b28606fff7cd1520d4c124ddd81d19f3.jpg[/img]

Your feedback and reports are extremely valuable to our team and we thank you in advance for taking the time to help us out. So, without further ado, let's take a look at what the 1.51 Open Beta has in store.

[b][h3]New Title Screen[/h3][/b]
One of the first and most prominent changes you will encounter in this update is a complete redesign of our Title Screen. Whilst keeping in line with our recent user interface rework, we wanted a design which is easy to navigate and understand for all players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4deb974d9131a271c3017de7a59548aaad5e61d7.jpg[/img]
First and foremost, one of the main difference you'll notice about the new Title Screen is the focus on a truck in the centre of the screen. On the left, you'll find the menu which allows easy access to the more important features of the game, such as Options, and other sub-menus such as the DLC (formerly DLC Browser) and the Mod Manager, which will display the number of MODs active next to it if you have any installed.

To access your Profile Manager, just simply click your profile widget located in the top right of the menu screen. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/67b899b64727db83f6db62cccb3b38076b53311f.jpg[/img]
Functionally, we have also made navigation more comfortable with a gamepad or a steering wheel, requiring less time reaching for a keyboard from the moment you launch ETS2 or ATS. This design also leaves us space to make tweaks and changes where needed, as well as make additions in the future.

We'd like to thank the community for their feedback on the first iteration of this Title Screen, which was showcased in a recent blog. We look forward to hearing your comments on this version during the 1.51 Open Beta.

[b][h3]Dynamic Cargo (Un)Loading of Grainhoppers[/h3][/b]
In the 1.50 update, we introduced a dynamic loading and unloading feature for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2543810/American_Truck_Simulator__Nebraska/]Nebraska DLC[/url]'s custom agriculture depots using a grain hopper trailer. Now, we are happy to reveal that in the 1.51 update for American Truck Simulator, we are going to add more animated loading options as well as depots where players will encounter this feature!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/5ffda622964c4680accea90f4184990d66aa912a.jpg[/img]
Truckers delivering with their own grain hopper trailer will experience dynamic loading and unloading when transporting corn, soybean, grain, sugar beet, pelleted animal food, potatoes, or cotton seed not only in Nebraska but also in custom depots found in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2298430/American_Truck_Simulator__Kansas/]Kansas DLC[/url], the upcoming Arkansas DLC, and in "prefab" depots across American Truck Simulator.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/b3041b12eb0ac54adc63c394c127e9e63df714b3.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/f733bb260fd853fdc237d9d3508593549a259aee.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/bb7cd66ae2dedf5eb04988ca4c4f88a92dbcf50d.jpg[/img]
You can read more about this feature in a [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2024/08/151-update-grain-hoppers-chip-vans.html]blogpost[/url] we recently released. We look forward to hearing your comments.

[b][h3]I-44 and more for Oklahoma DLC[/h3][/b]
The missing link along the I-44 has been frequently requested by our community, so we are glad to be able bring this new content as part of the upcoming 1.51 update for ATS. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/bdea40708ab7925aaddeb2b20aa13c5dfdd6ebe7.jpg[/img]
Currently in the Oklahoma DLC, the middle section of Interstate 44 through Oklahoma City is missing. However in the 1.51 update, we are happy to be able to bring this section in, connecting the western and eastern sections and completing I-44 in Oklahoma. This will of course come as a free update to all current owners of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2209650/American_Truck_Simulator__Oklahoma/]Oklahoma DLC[/url]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/b73c5ce8da1ea1bc00a455f84086587a6f602373.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/23d4bf0e79217dbe287b7b52f9710f7e2dbfaa78.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c162680b00bdf2eef115284dc651e598eff6ef02.jpg[/img]
That is not all however, the I-44 will also include two new depots for players to deliver to and from; a furniture store and a construction site. Along with this addition, players will also be treated to 2 new truck stops on the I-40. If you'd like to read more about these changes, check out the dedicated blog on this topic which we released recently.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/a46214416a01b5e0917cb6febccbf4a1c3f81112.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/944074cef5e6451117e0961d93bcfe0022ec3332.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/69769951bed2bfc5ebd072b854a593d33ca4209f.jpg[/img]
[b][h3]Vegetation Update for Texas DLC[/h3][/b]
In collaboration with our vegetation department, our map designers have replaced the older pines with the more accurate loblolly pines native to Texas! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/ec17bd85768a0a27c5ec55acfbbcd66a63c76169.jpg[/img]
The loblolly pines were initially created for the Arkansas DLC but also naturally grow in Texas. To enhance realism and ensure a smoother transition when driving between these states, truckers will now encounter an abundance of these trees throughout the entire eastern part of Texas - along roads, in forests, and within towns.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/ee5cf37938af47c90d218f5e002e680092bc55c7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/fa284e06f76c73b56b9f3bd55da2f5837d82d1c0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/7a2fe8edb772f40321b68ddb533034203e9ac8d1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/5188d3cb0b84e35559f4183f138145003efb94d6.jpg[/img]
We hope you will appreciate our teams' attention to detail, going back to previously released map expansions and updating them based on your feedback to correct any imperfections!

[b][h3]Custom City Intros for Oregon DLC[/h3][/b]
We are happy to share that we have now expanded Custom City Intros to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/800370/American_Truck_Simulator__Oregon/]Oregon DLC[/url] for American Truck Simulator! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/33a0a0427ee6f8e8d90a19138d2da16250281fa7.jpg[/img]
These special cutscenes appear when a player selects a starting city when creating a new profile. We hope that new players (or those restarting a new profile) will enjoy these new additions, showcasing the area where you have chosen to begin.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/d8b5d3e759cdf5c3c8281cb6bdc894d989088ca5.jpg[/img]
We hope you enjoy this addition, and we look forward to introducing it to more states in the future.

[b][h3]FlowBelow Update for Various Trucks [/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/b31075df32944ee190b9992a0a4e58e5e4168cbf.jpg[/img]
We've teamed up with FlowBelow to extend the possibilities if having the FlowBelow Tractor AeroKit™ installed on a number of trucks in American Truck Simulator. Players will now have the choice of having FlowBelow fairings and wheel covers on the following vehicles: 
[list]
[*] Kenworth T680
[*] Peterbilt 579
[*] Volvo VNL
[*] Mack Anthem

[*] Western Star 5700XE and 57X[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/b8e83e44bdb61f1dbd15752c6ec0e85b18496275.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/460bf31e13146c8e482d4ea7047d71d086cd6078.jpg[/img]
In the real world , the FlowBelow Tractor AeroKit™ delivers fuel savings for drivers on the road, and can be found installed on thousands of trucks across the United States. For players in American Truck Simulator, we're happy to bring this economical solution to your virtual fleet. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/c6b571d71024741ab498aafe9335fb8e136921ee.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/a14f685cdb81064b68365b2aece76c8605fbab27.jpg[/img]
It also has the added benefit of minimizing turbulence and improving aerodynamics by surrounding the drive wheels to better manage the air that moves around the tractor while in motion. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/9614e9b7545b002e215d185279bafec8063c1a9b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/a14f685cdb81064b68365b2aece76c8605fbab27.jpg[/img]
We hope that you enjoy using FlowBelow on your future journeys in American Truck Simulator, be sure to share pictures of your newly installed kit on our official social media channels. 

[b][h3]Options QoL Improvements [/h3][/b]
The main change is the addition of a search bar for easier navigation across all settings categories. When a search is conducted, matches will be displayed in the current setting category, and sections where the search term also appears will be highlighted.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/aa689d43c702f71c5eeb4e0f30ddde42a22fea15.jpg[/img]
We have also reorganized the existing options in the settings for better clarity. These options are now divided into subcategories within each section. Additionally, two new categories, "Interface" and "Accessibility," have been added to the bottom menu for better distribution.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/ee7b36461d15627d5fea3521a451b0eb663890e0.jpg[/img]

You can now change your menu background directly using a shortcut from the main menu, or alternatively, you can access the same option via the interface section in your settings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/b39cbb0e894f3abd62b84ca18f3a17012f9465a1.jpg[/img]
However, that's not all! We've now also made it possible to preview your backgrounds before changing them. Simply click on the background of your choice via the carousel, and you'll be presented with a short preview of how it would look, before confirming your selection. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/41513410829dcc17e038939c29738067fb681e5e.jpg[/img]
Players will also be notified through a small widget on the main menu if they have received a new Desktop Background option as part of an event reward or update. Clicking on this will also direct you to the new settings which are implemented in this update.

[b][h3]Changelog [/h3][/b]
[b]Map[/b]
[list][*] I-44 update for the Oklahoma DLC
[*] Vegetation update for the Texas DLC[/list]
[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list][*] Dynamic cargo (un)loading of Grain hoppers
[*] Vehicles
[*] FlowBelow update for various trucks[/list]
[b]UI[/b]
[list][*] New Title Screen
[*] Search bar added to the settings menu
[*] Accessibility and Interface categories added to the settings menu
[*]Improved changing of desktop background[/list]
[i]So enjoy all the new additions, but please remember: It's only an open beta, not a stable public version - so you may encounter bugs, instability, or crashes. It's completely okay if you want to wait for the final release. But if you're interested in helping us to get there faster, we'll appreciate all of your feedback on our forum and your [url=https://forum.scssoft.com/viewforum.php?f=330]bug reports in this section.[/url]

Please check our modding wiki to get details pertaining to mods for the game.
If you wish to participate in the open beta, you can find this version in the public_beta branch on Steam. The way to access it is as follows: Steam client → LIBRARY → right-click on American Truck Simulator  → Properties → Betas tab → public_beta → 1.51. No password is required. Sometimes you have to restart your Steam client to see the correct branch name there.[/i]

notes.title: 1.51 Update: New Title Screen
notes.notes:
With the upcoming 1.51 update for both Euro Truck Simulator 2 and American Truck Simulator, one of the first and most prominent changes players will encounter is a complete redesign of the title screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/3f1e6ac6ade2d49831f6b356e2b11f6e64346ff9.jpg[/img]
Whilst keeping in line with our recent user interface rework, we wanted a design which is easy to navigate and understand for all players. First and foremost, one of the main difference you'll notice about the new title screen is the focus on a truck in the centre of the screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/2941648781a31347efb010368d71c4d6c9503009.jpg[/img]
On the left side, you'll find the menu which allows easy access to the more important features of the game, such as Options, your Profile Manager, or other sub-menus such as the DLC Browser or Mod Manager which are now located under the 'Extras' part of the menu. You will also find the current version of the game displayed in the bottom left corner. If an update is available for the game, text above the version of the game will appear to notify you of that.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/236633a4fa81740268fdc06adf7d564726582c71.jpg[/img]
On the right side of the menu, you can find a widget featuring your currently selected profile and current trucker level. Hovering over this widget allows you quick glance at your profile statistics. In some cases, additional widgets may appear on the right side, for example, if your current profile is not connected to World of Trucks or if you are using a 'Open Beta' version of the game. 

On the bottom right, you'll find our carousel of small banners, which gives players quick and easy access to the latest news from our official blog and features graphics presenting our newest releases.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/b4a21e6d46d4164221fde69687fe80247cf68ced.jpg[/img]
Functionally, we have also made navigation more comfortable with a gamepad or a steering wheel, requiring less time reaching for a keyboard from the moment you launch ETS2 or ATS. This design also leaves us space to make tweaks and changes where needed, as-well as make additions in the future.

We hope you that enjoy this new look and overhaul of the Title Screen in the upcoming 1.51 update. Be sure to keep an eye our on our social media channels ([url=https://x.com/SCSSoftware]X[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/scssoft/]Facebook[/url]) for more news on other changes and additions found in this update. Until then, keep on truckin'!

notes.title: Under the Hood: International LT & LoneStar Update
notes.notes:
With the 1.50 update for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/]American Truck Simulator[/url], we updated the International LT & International LoneStar. Now that a few weeks have passed, we bring you an interview with Andi, our 3D Graphic Designer, who was the main person behind this wonderful redesign!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/e65ac471ea2b45617574869b583724e42b682a7c.jpg[/img]
For the International LT, we added new features and customizable options to selected parts of the truck, but also adjusted and polished some of the older parts and reworked the base geometry of the truck. The biggest upgrade was the addition of the S13 Integrated Powertrain which includes a new engine, the T14 transmission, and new accessories such as new chassis fairing extenders, bumper and grille options, FlowBelow fairings, an APU, blindspot detectors, and a completely new shorter day cab chassis. 

Both trucks also underwent a complete interior overhaul with updated textures and interior materials, new customizable interior cabinets, and functioning cabin physics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/03f9fc77970d6e7e2234a916d67ef1df4c44f176.jpg[/img]
"Initially, the task was to facelift the LT with the S13 upgrade - new exterior accessories and engine options. However, during the pre-production process, we found ourselves not happy with the overall quality of the model, especially compared to the current standard of making trucks. The interior was especially lacking, so we decided to spend more time on the LT and LoneStar which meant remodeling parts of the interior and exterior, as well as making brand-new textures," says Andi.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/14fc57158b9adb1d24ebc60c0e90dcd5d8f15fad.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/1428a79c57dcfa4aaec5f8016278629127eac9bf.jpg[/img]
Redesigning these two trucks was mainly a solo project done by Andi although, as he says, he had the support of his colleagues. 

"I was responsible for modeling new parts, texturing them, and integrating everything into our game engine. Oscar helped us source reference data in the form of CAD files, Mark helped me double-check the accessory options, and our QA department made sure that everything was ready for release. I had help from my team lead Jarda throughout the project, he oversaw it and provided feedback where necessary. We also had some help from our paint job department which had to re-export the old paint jobs to fit the updated UVs after the facelift, as well as making a new custom paint job for the S13 package," Andi shares with us.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/dc52e350d5f22500dc8355a5987d843d8322db04.jpg[/img]
The project started in April 2023 and was finalized in the winter, then released with the 1.50 update in May. "It's game development, so roadblocks and problems are to be expected. During the summer the project was put on hold because we were missing some vital reference data. But overall it went really well and I had a great time working on this facelift. The community response showed us that we did a good job with this project, especially the update on the interior," Andi tells us.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/a46b870304316c0d13762ae666d5e3c71ca3b5bb.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/01e49d837297d76a8cf2acef971b2145f613e132.jpg[/img]
What did Andi enjoy the most while working on this project? "For me, it was definitely modeling the new steel bumper and the new S13 grille, they were quite a challenge but I really love modeling such complex curved shapes. The interior refresh was definitely a lot of fun to work on as well since I got to use Substance Designer to create new tileable textures and it was a really enjoyable experience overall. Watching the interior change over time to what it is now was pure joy," he says.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/2f4d3f5f464d76db2c23f17f548c722adb69b622.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/d04b8a03a02f6ee39182b8fe701591bafe2a5273.jpg[/img]
On the other hand, the most challenging part was integrating everything into the engine. "Especially on a truck such as this, that has been in the game for a few years, I had to be extremely careful what I changed, otherwise we could break a player's savegame. Every change on an existing part required additional work to create a save patch. There was an issue with the cabin deflector logic that I had changed, which proved to be too problematic to resolve, so it had to be reverted. These are unavoidable things when working in game development, and navigating them properly is always a challenge," Andi says.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/b6810f41a93b46f5ba4a07129524f567d40b9aae.jpg[/img]
Andi is a big fan of the refreshed look of the International LT, so this project was really made for him. "I love the slick and sporty look of the LT. My favorite configuration is the Skyrise cabin with the S13 grille, S13 painted bumper, painted side skirts with the new closeouts, new roof extender, and painted all in a bright yellow," he told us.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4036972/6d86950704bd3bef653630730378d08c8f335eea.jpg[/img]
We want to thank our friends at International Trucks who provided us with all of the reference data. And we hope you have enjoyed driving with these refreshed trucks so far! If you like them, make sure to share some screenshots with us on our social media ([url=https://x.com/SCSsoftware]X/Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/scs.software/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/americantrucksimulator.scs]Facebook[/url], and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@scssoftware]TikTok[/url]), we really want to see those!

notes.title: JCB Equipment Pack Release
notes.notes:
JCB is one of the world's top manufacturers of construction equipment, recognised globally by their signature yellow colour. Established in 1945, JCB's product line encompasses a wide range of machinery, including excavators, loaders, compactors, telehandlers, tractors and more. Renowned for their innovation and reliability, JCB machines are widely used in construction projects, agriculture, infrastructure development, and various industrial applications worldwide.

[previewyoutube=iXKxtoSHQyw;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=YXjorDUFtmw;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.notes:
Today is the day, engines at the ready! The Nebraska DLC for American Truck Simulator releases today and we can't wait for you to get haulin'. Are you ready to explore Cornhusker State and that it has to offer? Let's get get cruising!

[list]
[*] Deliver to 12 explorable cities including Lincoln, Omaha, North Platte, or Grand Island
[*] See several landmarks unique to Nebraska such as Carhenge, Scott Bluff National Monument, Archway Monument, McConaughy Lake, and many other memorials and iconic murals
[*] Become a trucker transporting goods to Nebraska's key industries – RV dealers, Utility Vehicle Factory, Soybean factories and various custom made farms
[*] Deliver cargo to the Sugar Beet Factory located in Scottsbluff, with its iconic tall storage silos
[*] Experience the brand new dynamic loading & unloading feature while delivering to selected agricultural depots 
[*] Play a crucial role in one of America's major agricultural states. Transport corn, soybeans, sugar beat, grain and other produce that sustain Nebraska's farming legacy
[*] Pick up cargo at the world’s largest train yard, the Baily Yard in North Platte and become a direct link to the state’s expansive railroad network
[*] Enjoy trucking through 20 scenic towns (settlements)
[*] Drive through expansive prairies, providing unforgettable views
[*] Discover hidden treasures of Nebraska’s countryside, viewpoints, easter eggs, and follow the historic Oregon Trail[/list]
