notes.title: #CruisingColorado Event Update
notes.notes:
It took our #BestCommunityEver only 7 days to drive 60,000,000 miles in the currently ongoing #CruisingColorado World of Trucks event to pass the community goal. We are left speechless once again. Actually, you guys and gals have reached it so quickly we might even ask you to show us your cabin logbooks to check if you have had your regular driving breaks?! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/2d60f5eaedf544d09957ba1275f7e506c972819d.jpg[/img]

Don't worry, we're just joking here. But it's always cool and motivating to see how fast and easily our fanbase can smash the "quests" we set for them. And how many of you are always ready to immediately join the events we create for you. We also love seeing all your tweets and posts under the #CruisingColorado hashtag over at any social media challenge we monitor. Want some number? Well, so far there have been posted more than [url=https://twitter.com/search?q=%23CruisingColorado&src=typed_query&f=live]1100 tweets[/url] on Twitter and [url=https://www.instagram.com/explore/tags/cruisingcolorado/]280 posts[/url] on Instagram! 

[url=https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-63sW7n0yYLc/X7ugCc8vADI/AAAAAAAAXLE/5699oU_KXgUWHQuRm0pCv-ADjSf4gHT0QCLcBGAsYHQ/s1280/socky_crusing_colorado.gif][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-63sW7n0yYLc/X7ugCc8vADI/AAAAAAAAXLE/5699oU_KXgUWHQuRm0pCv-ADjSf4gHT0QCLcBGAsYHQ/w640-h360/socky_crusing_colorado.gif[/img][/url]

According to the reactions and feedback upon the rewards which can be claimed in this event, for both personal and community goals, we guess you really like the new paint job and hanging cabin accessory. Don't forget to share how it fits your favorite truck, pals! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/44ae1786e03d9754a85896ac6f75e322274e6cbb.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/99edd79d6912927101a783fc475a272dd00b21ee.jpg[/img]

Even though we tried to explain it in our previous blog posts and communication over at our social media channels, we still have received some questions about the date till when this event is going to be kept active, or requests to not end this event even while the community goal is already reached. So please let us say it again here - you do not need to worry, because [b][u]we will keep the event running until well after Christmas, so there will be plenty of time to relax and enjoy the ride while earning your rewards.[/u][/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1209471/American_Truck_Simulator__Colorado/

notes.title: Colorado Release
notes.notes:
[b]The big day is here![/b] Preparations to release [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1209471/American_Truck_Simulator__Colorado/]Colorado for American Truck Simulator[/url] are in top gear. We are also preparing for a special release stream with special guests. So when exactly is Colorado releasing?

[b][h1]Colorado for American Truck Simulator will be released at 7pm Central European Time[/h1][/b][h3][b][i]( 10am PST, 1pm EST, 6pm GMT, 7pm MSK, 2am SST₊₁, 5am AEDT₊₁ , 7am NZDT₊₁ )[/i][/b][/h3]

[previewyoutube=SiTFH7WXapU;full][/previewyoutube]
So what exactly does our Colorado DLC have to offer for truckers? These are just a few of the things we think you will love! 

[list]
[*] Drive from the great plains, through the Rocky Mountains to bustling cities and historical towns.
[*] Haul cargo on the Million Dollar Highway
[*] Discover Colorado's important industries like wind power factories or gold mines
[*] Deliver freight to and from the inside of a large cargo aircraft in Denver International Airport
[*] Admire representation of cities like Denver, Colorado Springs and many others
[*] Visit landmarks like the Four Corners Monument and get a bird's-eye view on it with the viewpoint feature
[*] Unlock Colorado-specific Steam achievements
[*] and Much More!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/73cf6522fc6411f7a60c92f785173a3c59cd9419.jpg[/img]

And that shouldn't be the only reason to explore Colorado for yourself! As an added bonus we will also have a World of Trucks event for all new visitors to Colorado with unique rewards to be earned as you visit each city and deliver jobs. Learn more about the rules in our [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2020/11/cruisingcolorado-event-announcement.html]yesterday blog post[/url] and take part in [b]#CruisingColorado[/b] at [url=http://WorldofTrucks.com]WorldofTrucks.com[/url]. We'd love to see your photos across our Social Media channels using the hashtag!

We expect to have this event available to players for an extended period of time, probably way beyond the point of reaching the 60 million miles which is the current community goal. We don't want to motivate you to rush through the DLC in a hurry to make sure you manage to obtain the personal achievement. We simply want to reward early adopters of the DLC for spending quality time with the new content.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/f12cf0389de88109f624dd8629c78b04f7cdbfac.jpg[/img]

We will also be hosting a special Colorado release live-stream across official [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1209471/American_Truck_Simulator__Colorado/]Steam[/url] & [url=https://www.twitch.tv/scssoftware]Twitch[/url] channels starting at 16:00 CET. 

Don't miss out on this broadcast as we talk with members of the map and research teams involved in the creation of Colorado and a special guest appearance from Pavel Šebor CEO of SCS Software! We will be answering questions from the community, talking in-depth about the DLC and of course, releasing Colorado LIVE on stream!

We hope you enjoy exploring what Colorado has to offer, we will see you on the roads!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1209471/American_Truck_Simulator__Colorado/

notes.title: Colorado Release Date Annoucement
notes.notes:
With the final touches being made to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1209471/American_Truck_Simulator__Colorado/]Colorado DLC[/url], we are excited to announce a release date for this [i]colorful[/i] addition to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/]American Truck Simulator[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/5fc3fd79ead55cc4a848746a3bc217f22d789570.jpg[/img]

[b]Colorado will be released on the 12th of November 2020![/b]

And if that announcement date hasn't got you excited enough, then we are sure that this video trailer showcasing Colorado will! 

[previewyoutube=SiTFH7WXapU;full][/previewyoutube]
That is not all however,  prior to Colorado's release, we will be hosting a very special release live-stream on the 12th of November, starting at around 15:00 CET. This stream will feature a variety of special guests involved in the creation of this DLC along with the possibility of a few extra surprises too. You can watch along live on the day at our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/scssoftware]official Twitch channel[/url] or on our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1209471/American_Truck_Simulator__Colorado/]Steam store page[/url], don't miss out! 

We also plan to bring a special [url=https://worldoftrucks.com/en/]World of Trucks[/url] in-game event with the release of this map expansion. Keep an eye out here on our blog for more information on how you can take part and how you can earn in-game rewards, next week.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/6171b4ec8f5abf2dbda4827e1b9b5866399ce5cb.jpg[/img]

The release of Colorado isn't the only BIG news, however! We are happy to share that owners of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/962750/American_Truck_Simulator__Special_Transport/]Special Transport DLC[/url] will have [b]3 new routes[/b] to take on in our upcoming map expansion. These new routes are: 

[list]
[b][*] Denver Airport to Grand Junction
[*] Sterling to Colorado Springs
[*] Denver Train Depot to Gold Mine near Colorado Springs[/b]
[/list]
Each journey will come with its own challenges. So make sure to adhere to the GPS advisor and speed limit which have been set out for you before your departure, as there is no room for mistakes!

notes.title: ATS 1.39 Update Release
notes.notes:
With lots of testing, feedback, fixing, and fine-tuning, we are excited to announce the arrival of update the 1.39 for American Truck Simulator!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/1662589f96b32b35e2e5571134f508f071c37c33.jpg[/img]

We'd like to thank all those who took part in the 1.39 open beta and made bug reports and provided general feedback on this new version. We hope you can now begin to fully enjoy the various new features which are included within this update. So, what can you expect to find in the 1.39 update ATS?

 Lets us give you a quick recap of the most significant changes.

[previewyoutube=QGNhMXpyl6A;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]LAUNCHPAD UPDATE[/b]

One of the first things you may notice when you launch American Truck Simulator with the 1.39 is a redesign of the current launchpad. The main reason why we are introducing this change is to pave the way for future additions; which will introduce new features to our games, that will be accessed through the launchpad.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/4289432fa0834ba8a4bb521e59abd8c756c1b3c4.png[/img]

Until then, however, you can see that the design has changed quite significantly, especially as user profiles are now accessed via a drop-down option from the top of the launchpad. You will also find that the DLC Browser, Mod Manager, and Profile Manager have been placed together for easier access, along with a new addition to the launchpad, Game Options. 

This allows you to change your game settings without even having to load the game. So if you're just looking to tweak your game before streaming on Twitch or adjusting a few options before heading into your truck, it can all be done from the launchpad screen. 

[b]LOWBOY TRAILERS[/b]

As we previously announced in a [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2020/09/american-truck-simulator-lowboy-trailers.html]recent blog[/url], new Lowboy Trailers will be arriving to American Truck Simulator. These trailers have been reworked from the ground up, offering drivers the option to purchase them and use them in an array of different jobs including [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/962750/American_Truck_Simulator__Special_Transport/]Special Transport[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1076080/American_Truck_Simulator__Forest_Machinery/]Forest Machinery[/url], and the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/620610/American_Truck_Simulator__Heavy_Cargo_Pack/]Heavy Cargo DLC's[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/804ddce8cc740df895427a9a73858ad6a9fbf3e6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/7f3d95272c437c806cd95d910de861321b611f60.jpg[/img]

Owners of these trailers will benefit from a wide array of options to customize them in the upgrade shop, such as color, trailer accessories, beacons, chassis options, lengths, articulated axles, and more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/51d5a97a14118d82f28623764a4048e70d22f03b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/465d859bb422e8fff0097e2e65b88e28f5ea745b.jpg[/img]

You will also be able to spot them being hauled around by other truckers on the road, so make sure to give them plenty of space if you pass by one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/5284d04f3c49794e9c17d393a172459264ae8b4e.jpg[/img]

[b]VIEWPOINTS[/b]

The release of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1209470/American_Truck_Simulator__Idaho/]Idaho[/url] for American Truck Simulator saw the introduction of a brand new feature that has not been placed in any other previous map release. Viewpoints allow drivers to activate a special in-game "cutscene" with a short showcase of a near location or place of interest such as an industry.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/281630782f69e4e74765160e76f2731e32d3432f.jpg[/img]

After Idaho's release, it was evident from the community's response that this was a popular feature and one that many of you would like to see expanded upon. While we continue to improve this new addition, we are excited to announce that viewpoints will be arriving in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1015160/American_Truck_Simulator__Washington/]Washington[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1104880/American_Truck_Simulator__Utah/]Utah[/url]. Each state will receive 10 new cut-scenes to discover, which can be found nearby famous landmarks, national parks, and industries. 

[table][tr][td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/73a466b1602d3f0e150471f2d60b5e1cc927be1e.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/73a466b1602d3f0e150471f2d60b5e1cc927be1e.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/21c83666fcc86274da2f38c06abd37fb76f870ab.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/21c83666fcc86274da2f38c06abd37fb76f870ab.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table][table][tr]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/fb90adb1a6238510fe165a3607c08a9d9a371122.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/fb90adb1a6238510fe165a3607c08a9d9a371122.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/3f712d0e1d64dd99a8598ca3ef956547ae0a3552.jpg[/img][/tr][/table]

That is not all, however, as viewpoints will now feature a few new functionalities for drivers. You will now have the new options to either skip the viewpoint or replay it if you wish to watch it again. Viewpoints will now also show as undiscovered grey '?' icons on your map until you have visited them for the first time. Also, there are more improvements for this cool new feature still in development, as we've gathered them through the amazing and most valuable feedback from our #BestCommunityEver!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/651d6b8fc2ccce82d05429540f3df3e2d4c74326.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/bbff0d5aad9de65fa74e7d4d25383937746d6cb4.jpg[/img]


[b]GENERAL BUG FIXES/SOUND CHANGES[/b]

1.39 also features various bug fixes, improvements, and an update to sounds. This includes, but is not limited to, improved interior cab sound mixing, Western Star 49X truck bug fixes, and improvements, and other changes in preparation for new and upcoming content.

One of the changes you can find is the addition of the Turbo sound slider in the game's Options screen. When we introduced a separate channel for turbo sound some years back, it was hailed as a crucial enhancement to the simulation. We did our best to tune it properly based on actual in-cabin recordings. Indeed, many players commented very positively on it. However, over the years we have also been receiving feedback that the whistling sound may be too difficult to bear for some players. The new slider continues the trend of giving you more control over your simulation experience. We hope you enjoy this new addition plus a few other sound tweaks which come with it.

While a majority of the changes in 1.39 are not seen visually in this version, we look forward to bringing you more content and changes in the near future. 

[b]CHANGELOG[/b]

[b]MAP[/b]
[list]
[*] New Viewpoints in Washington and Utah DLCs
[/list]

[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*] Launchpad Re-design
[/list]

[b]VEHICLES[/b]
[list]
[*] Lowboy trailers (ownable, including articulated ones)
[/list]

[b]FEATURES[/b]
[list]
[*] Viewpoint improvements (replayability, skip, map status, fade-out)
[*] Sound updates and improvements (turbo slider, sound positioning, cabin spatial mixing, sound distribution to accessories)
[*] Trailer browser & lister shows all valid cargo variants
[*] Experimental transmission input shaft emulation and clutch brake support (g_clutch_brake)
[/list]

notes.title: American Truck Simulator: Wheel Tuning Pack DLC Update
notes.notes:
Traditionally, a trucker in American Truck Simulator will spend their time driving mostly on tarmacked highways and roads on long haul journeys, however with the introduction of new industries in different states, it is no longer uncommon to find a job contract that delivers to an area off-road.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/008b82d76f768b3c712f0e47de8beb2869c63648.jpg[/img]

With the continual development of our trucking titles, comes new industries and jobs, some of which require the drivers to move heavy and often large loads around off-road areas such as active mines on gravel roads and logging areas which are often hilly and muddy. Our next update to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/450550/American_Truck_Simulator__Wheel_Tuning_Pack/]ATS Wheel Tuning Pack DLC[/url] aims to help drivers who take these kind of jobs mores often.  

[table][tr][td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e4cc5e83b5995c9f7bdd4db0e7c3e824622a9534.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e4cc5e83b5995c9f7bdd4db0e7c3e824622a9534.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/a00e6cd2655100fd716b4a4f7f5d339f0e7e190e.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/a00e6cd2655100fd716b4a4f7f5d339f0e7e190e.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table][table][tr]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e10415db0ebc70761834b00ea4ce2d20de4700e4.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e10415db0ebc70761834b00ea4ce2d20de4700e4.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table]
Today, we are happy to announce that new heavy-duty wheels will be arriving in the Wheel Tuning Pack DLC for American Truck Simulator. The new tyre has a deeper tread, plus a larger and wider size made from thicker rubber, which is the perfect combination for off-road truckers, but that isn't all.   

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/864f1c49e150220f812da556bd5fd43a326fc258.jpg[/img]

We are also updating all of our existing 14 rim designs so that they can fit our new wider heavy-duty wheels as well as rear super-single wheels. This mean you can continue to use your favorite rim designs for any job on or off-road.

[table][tr][td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/feac016eee77198ece1479ca82cbfd37e8f733d3.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/feac016eee77198ece1479ca82cbfd37e8f733d3.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/44a89dc2d87757271f94003bfaea3ec083c0808c.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/44a89dc2d87757271f94003bfaea3ec083c0808c.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table]
We hope you will enjoy this update to the Wheel Tuning Pack for ATS. We know how important it is for drivers to look after their truck with the right equipment and parts, so we are excited to see how the community will utilize these new additions. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/27ebefa5f11032cebc1186ecd9f68239b2410807.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Idaho Release
notes.notes:
The day has come and so has [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1209470/American_Truck_Simulator__Idaho/]Idaho[/url]! Preparations for a release party are in top gear! We are also preparing for a special release stream with special guests. So when exactly is Idaho releasing?

[h3][b]Idaho for American Truck Simulator will be released at
09:00 PDT / 12:00 EST / 17:00 BST / 18:00 CEST /
 00:00 ₊₁ SGT / 02:00 ₊₁ AEST[/b][/h3]

[previewyoutube=4e0uztR4Ydk;full][/previewyoutube]

So what exactly does Idaho have to offer? This new expansion features:
[list][*]Over 3,300 miles of new roads to discover and explore[/*][*]11 new cities - drive through downtown Boise, Coeur d'Alene set on a gorgeous lake or Idaho Falls with a lovely touristic center[/*][*]A brand new viewpoint feature that gives you a new perspective of the world[/*][*]Expanded fan-favorite industries such as farming, timber harvesting or wood processing[/*][*]Visit the famous Craters of the Moon National Monument and Preserve[/*][*]Over 40 recognizable spots from the Historical Highway Marker program[/*][*]State-specific geographical landmarks such as canyons, valleys or basalt rock formations[/*][*]Many familiar truck stops and rest areas that truckers will know from the real world[/*][*]Finely-tuned road layouts and true-to-life signage[/*][*]Idaho-specific achievements to unlock[/*][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/00eb4813d471592e24614d7076edf43f96337c18.jpg[/img]

And that shouldn't be the only reason to explore the State for yourself! As an added bonus we will also have a World of Trucks event for all new visitors to Idaho with unique rewards to be earned as you visit each city and deliver jobs. Learn more about the rules in our [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2020/07/cruising-idaho-event.html]yesterday blog post[/url] and take part in [b]#CruisingIdaho[/b] at [url=https://worldoftrucks.com/en/]WorldofTrucks.com[/url]. We'd love to see your photos across our Social Media channels using the hashtag!

We expect to have this event available to players for an extended period of time, probably way beyond the point of reaching the 30 million miles community goal. We don't want to motivate you to rush through the DLC in a hurry to make sure you manage to obtain the personal achievement. We simply want to reward early adopters of the DLC for spending quality time with the new content.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/9f30419431304200efd19f890cc5fe88d618da5f.jpg[/img]

We will also be hosting a special Idaho release live-stream across Steam & Twitch starting at 15:00 CEST. Don't miss out on this broadcast as we talk with members of the map and research teams involved in the creation of Idaho and a special guest appearance from Pavel Šebor CEO of SCS Software! We will be answering questions from the community, talking in-depth about the DLC and of course, releasing Idaho LIVE on stream!

With the release of Idaho, we will also be making a new special Steam discount bundle available. Introducing the Pacific Northwest bundle which includes the American Truck Simulator base game as well as Idaho, Washington, Oregon, Forest Machinery DLCs, and the Classic Stripes Paint Jobs Pack. The way Steam bundles work, it's both a perfect bundle for any new drivers who are keen to make a start in their new truckin' career, as well as a way for the loyal fans to obtain the new DLC at a nice discount if you already own the previous DLCs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/21696c3bcae6dae8b2de6211f450e5bf7364bccb.jpg[/img]

We hope you enjoy exploring what Idaho has to offer, we will see you on the roads!

You can find a more [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2020/06/ats-138-las-vegas-revamp.html]in-depth blog post[/url] on the subject which showcases many of the changes found in and around the city. But the best way to see it all is to see the city for yourself! So be sure to make that trip to Nevada and let us know what you think through our social media channels.

[table][tr][td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/6e632b5379c1a8142524dcdd7a48288b150100b8.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/6e632b5379c1a8142524dcdd7a48288b150100b8.jpg[/img][/url][/td]

Las Vegas isn't the only part of the American Truck Simulator world to receive an update in 1.38, one of the more noticeable changes are to Truckstops. One of the first changes you will notice at Truckstops in ATS is that fuel stations now have lanes with appropriate width for trucks to pull up and refuel in. We have also implemented (where possible) guidance lines to help drivers line up their trucks to avoid damaging their vehicles upon entry and exit. Plus there is a completely new truck stop placed on the US-111 road now!

[table][tr][td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/f0e4bba3ebb1861041c7a781828875072110f2e7.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/f0e4bba3ebb1861041c7a781828875072110f2e7.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/eabd1a4d221e03b0f807d4e2c29eb93dc3ec017e.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/eabd1a4d221e03b0f807d4e2c29eb93dc3ec017e.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table]

We are also excited to introduce the inclusion of a computer graphics technique for efficiently approximating ambient occlusion effects in real-time. Screen Space Ambient Occlusion, better known in its shorter form SSAO, creates shadows in the areas where objects connect, to give it a more natural and believable look in terms of lighting and shadows.

Less powerful GPUs may struggle to keep up at full quality, and with 400% or similarly high scaling selected, even mid-range machines would feel the impact on fps. If you are not happy with framerate after this update, please open the advanced graphics options in the game and try to find the right combination of scaling and SSAO quality for you. With a weaker GPU, it may be advisable to switch off SSAO completely.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/6c7bca7406dadb949f8236138dae466e858a3b5a.jpg[/img]

This new feature can be better explained by one of our senior programmers, be sure to read a more in-depth post about the topic at our Under the Hood blog post[url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2020/07/under-hood-explaining-ssao.html] here [/url]

We are also excited to introduce a long-requested update to the RGB Color Picker which drivers use to paint their trucks when purchasing or tuning their truck. You now have the option to input specific color inputs (HSV, RGB, and HEX).

We know that many drivers like to match their truck colors the same across their whole fleet, so we hope this feature is useful to you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/d71b7c58ad880db653e18f612f8ffb008a6b5da6.jpg[/img]

There is much more packed into this update! If you would like a more in-depth read of other features included in this update, take a read of [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2020/06/ats-138-open-beta.html]our previous blogpost[/url] for the 1.38 Open Beta.

[b]MAP[/b]
[list]
[*] Las Vegas city revamped (I-515/I-11 interstate bypass + the whole city switched to the template road system)
[*] US-191 road implemented
[*] UT-56 road implemented + reskin of a little stretch of US-93 around Panaca settlement
[*] CA-111 - new truckstop added
[*] El Centro revamped
[*] New company in Logan, UT (Plaster & Sons)

[*] NM Shiprock redesigned + piece of US-491
[*] Various map fixes
[/list]

[b]VEHICLES[/b]
[list]
[*] Automatic transmission improved (shifting points, adaptive modes)
[*] Las Vegas: New ambulance and fire trucks
[*] Fixed steering deadzone
[/list]

[b]FEATURES[/b]
[list]
[*] Visual improvement - procedural ambient occlusion generation (SSAO)
[*] Route Advisor redesigned
[*] Navigation ETA to the next waypoint in route advisor and in world map
[*] Tobii eye-tracking presets
[*] RGB color picker redesigned
[*] Added RGB, HSV and HEX inputs
[*] User defined color presets
[/list]

[b]SOUND[/b]
[list]
[*] Update to FMOD 2.01.01
[*] Fixed the retarder sound when the engine is off
[*] AI - exclusion of gear-shifts for trains and electric vehicles
[/list]

[b]To enjoy the 1.38 update, make sure to OPT OUT of beta branches and your game will be automatically updated on Steam.[/b]

[b]Some mods, however, may have not caught up yet - this update may effectively break them. So remember that you can always stay on 1.37 or an even older branch. The way to access and select them is: Steam client → LIBRARY → right-click on American Truck Simulator → Properties → Betas tab → select the version you want.[/b]

notes.title: American Truck Simulator 1.37 Release
notes.notes:
After much testing, feedback, fixing and fine tuning, we are excited to announce the arrival of update 1.37 for American Truck Simulator! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/884a6c61b5c9c57d49a545ecd47ff6f9609e4dac.jpg[/img]

We'd like to thank every single one of you for all your help with your bug reports, opinions and general feedback during the Open Beta. We hope you can now begin to fully enjoy the new features included within this update.

[previewyoutube=8ijYxjqM1_w;full][/previewyoutube]
The main feature included with this update is the implementation of our new sound engine based on the powerful and flexible FMOD library; which radically redefines the way we mix vehicle and environment sounds. This update includes new sounds for most of the AIs (including trains) and the inclusion of a true Doppler effect for passing vehicles. This also brings an array of new sound options for users accessed from the main menu, that allows you to tweak many more individual sounds to your liking.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/ac31c40233d233d0fed703c6074b078ef6caefc3.jpg[/img]

While there is still a lot of tweaking to do and more sounds to arrive, this is only the first phase. We will continue to improve on feedback and implement changes throughout the year to come.

As a benefit from the new sound mixing approach, we are happy to bring you truck windows that you can open! You can now enjoy the continuum of sound levels between a well-insulated cabin with windows closed and the roaring traffic coming from the outside when you roll the windows all the way down. Give it a try especially when you hit the rush hour on the road or at a big junction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/ac97b32e50e4d93c145c981f3ae6cf6812e3ce56.jpg[/img]

Another addition that arrives with this update is our "walk-around feature." Our game world is generally not designed for exploration on foot, but we figure that fans of trucks may welcome a new closer perspective to view their favorite machines and appreciate how impressive they look. Getting up close may also be of use when you need to tune up your rig and match the color of your rims with the cabin's paint just right. So here we are with a little bonus feature of 1.37, an alternate way to control the camera in the game's service and vehicle browser. We had to redesign the "garage" scene a little to make more space and way for the cameras, hopefully, you will appreciate it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/fc350fe698309b64a777ef28f954be6d51062a40.jpg[/img]

Hungry for more? Then get ready for some food tanks! And we mean literally food tanks because, with this update, a new type of trailer comes available to buy. Also, when we speak about trailers - bulk feed and hopper trailers can now be customized with multiple paint jobs (including the Classic Stripes and Halloween Paint Job packs).

notes.title: American Truck Simulator Update 1.37 Open Beta is here!
notes.notes:
We love to bring you new game updates, especially when they contain some cool features that you have requested for a long time; and we really appreciate all the help our great community provides with testing each new update during the open beta stage. Today, we'd like to invite you to help us finalize the features that are coming to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/]American Truck Simulator[/url] along with the next update. Please read below, and if you like living on the edge, get ready to join the 1.37 Update Open Beta.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/e72ab34fc58af16c7c05ea6789ac43faa706e808.jpg[/img]

So what's coming with it, you ask? Let's start with the major thing on the list - a new sound engine! As you probably read in our first tease of this development (if not then you can read it [url=https://blog.scssoft.com/2020/02/fmod-first-tease.html]here[/url]), this is the first planned phase of bringing new and better sounds to our games. With the 1.37 update, we are radically redefining the way we mix vehicle and environment sounds. We are switching from having two separate sound sets for the interior and exterior of your truck; to a new system which is based on a unified sfx set with various filters and effects applied on it during the final composition. 

The end result sounds fantastic to our ears already, and we are just getting started. We are really looking forward to your reaction! You can also expect new sound for most of the AIs (includingtrains) and experience true [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Doppler_effect]Doppler effect[/url] as the first fruits from the integration of the FMOD sound library.

[previewyoutube=p20ej7eh-ec;full][/previewyoutube]
As a benefit from the new sound mixing approach, we are happy to bring you a new feature that we have already quietly teased [url=https://twitter.com/SCSsoftware/status/1228650412653338626]here[/url]. Did you spot it? At long last, you can open your truck windows! Some may consider it a gimmick, but many of you have been calling us to introduce this feature for years. So at long last, you can enjoy the continuum of sound levels between a well-insulated cabin with windows closed and the roaring traffic coming from the outside when you roll the windows all the way down. Give it a try especially when you hit a rush hour on the road or at some big junction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/ac97b32e50e4d93c145c981f3ae6cf6812e3ce56.jpg[/img]

[/u]Back to the most important thing, your help! We are releasing this open beta today with sound modders in mind. The changes are radical from their point of view, as they will need to re-learn a lot of the techniques used. We appreciate our modding communities passion and dedication and we expect modders to be able to raise the bar again as they become familiar with the new way to implement sounds into the game. 

We are bringing out the open beta early as we are eagerly looking forward to receiving your feedback and constructive criticism to be able to iterate where needed. Because our programmers and SFX guys have already invested a huge amount of time into this feature, we understand there is still a lot of work ahead of us. If you want to read more and help us with this task, please visit the dedicated modding wiki at [url=https://modding.scssoft.com/wiki/Games/ETS2/Modding_guides/1.37]this link[/url]. More info will be added there during the open beta. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/ac31c40233d233d0fed703c6074b078ef6caefc3.jpg[/img]

Another addition you might have spotted in a recent [url=https://twitter.com/SCSsoftware/status/1230464220086652930]social media teaser[/url] is the "walk-around feature." Our game world is generally not in shape for exploration on foot, but we figure that fans of trucks may appreciate a new closer perspective to view their favorite machines and appreciate how impressive they look. Getting up close may be also of use when you need to tune up your rig and match the color of your rims with the cabin's paint just right. So here we are with a little bonus feature of 1.37, an alternate way to control the camera in the game's garage. We had to redesign the garage scene a little to make more way for the cameras, hopefully you will appreciate it. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/fc350fe698309b64a777ef28f954be6d51062a40.jpg[/img]

Hungry for more? Then get ready for some food tanks! And we mean literally food tanks because, with this update, a new type of trailer comes available to buy and customize. These beauties were highly demanded for some time and so we're glad and proud we can bring them for you, our #BestCommunityEver!

notes.title: American Truck Simulator Update 1.36
notes.notes:
You saw what's coming (that's right - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1104880/American_Truck_Simulator__Utah/]Utah[/url] is almost here!) and you know what needs to come before - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/]American Truck Simulator[/url] Update 1.36 is here!

And before we get to the details, we'd like to thank every single one of you for all your help - with your bug reports, opinions and general feedback during the Public Beta. While the changelog isn't as big as the previous one, the system changes are huge and the impacts unpredictable in some parts of our game so your help was vital in catching all the major issues.

The most important change is the upgrade to DirectX 11, which allows us to drop DirectX 9 completely and the limitations it presented. Public Beta feedback shows that most of our players have enjoyed a nice FPS increase. Since our game's minimum requirements for Windows already support DX11, we do hope you'll all enjoy the improved performance.

Besides that, you'll get three new trailers, some map improvements and rebuilds, plus a nice number of new features, including a long-requested feature for drivers, trucks and trailers to be visible on the manager map!

For those wishing to see a more detailed changelog, please read the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/3580850447637978362]Public Beta[/url] article, or check out our changelog video!

[previewyoutube=82F9aISio3c;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]To enjoy Update 1.36,  make sure to OPT OUT of beta branches and your game will be automatically updated on Steam.[/b]

Some mods, however, may not have been updated yet - this update can effectively break them; remember that you can always stay on 1.35 or an even older branch. Follow these instructions to access and select them: Steam client → LIBRARY → right-click on American Truck Simulator → Properties → Betas tab → select the version you want.

Also, check our [url=https://modding.scssoft.com/wiki/Games/ETS2/Modding_guides/1.36]modding wiki[/url] to get details pertaining to mods for the game.

As we didn't talk much about this update, except on yesterday's [url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/492268167]stream[/url] (you couldn't resist, could you Pavel?), we presume it's a little bit of a mystery to most of you - so let's go through the list before you try out the Open Beta for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/]American Truck Simulator[/url]'s 1.36 Update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/bd76fc42e030f841f9068a1f3b330abc43350829.jpg[/img]

A word of warning first - [b][u]avoid this Beta if you are planning on completing any more deliveries in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/1586881524729816728]Pink Ribbon Event[/url][/u][/b] - it's not supported on 1.36 and you [b][u]WON'T[/u][/b] be able to go back to any older version of the game with a profile modified by the 1.36 version of the game. There are core changes, including a different save version - so back up the profiles that you want to keep (do a manual back up just to be sure) using on 1.35 or older versions.

A big focus of the update is on [b]DirectX 11[/b] (11.1 to be exact). We've decided to drop support for DirectX 9 for the sake of faster and easier development. So from Update 1.36 onwards, our games won't be compatible with systems running on DirectX 9.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/aa7fb54efe6c07492ba7761b658bfb4c199b0a91.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/aa7fb54efe6c07492ba7761b658bfb4c199b0a91.jpg[/img][/url]

While 1.36 isn't exactly "packed" with the new content, it mainly serves to push the DirectX change and as a "compatibility patch" for the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1104880/American_Truck_Simulator__Utah/]upcoming Utah map DLC[/url] - we couldn't help but cram in some new toys too :) These include a Grain hopper trailer and a Bulk feed trailer - both ownable, and a Frac-tank trailer too - which can't be purchased as it's basically the same thing as a road barrier (you take it from place A to place B, no reason to own it).

[table][tr]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/914ebd6592aa78b6b1ac9e60147778ec4f478764.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/914ebd6592aa78b6b1ac9e60147778ec4f478764.jpg[/img][/url][/td]

[/tr][/table]

And to have some "new" ground for driving these, we've revamped two cities in the base game - Flagstaff in Arizona and Santa Cruz in California, which also gets an improvement in posted speed limits. Oregon and New Mexico benefit too from the latter, in addition to other general sign improvements.

[table][tr]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/7e6905cd1d8996937a94e77cf8e0127d79c2bc04.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/7e6905cd1d8996937a94e77cf8e0127d79c2bc04.jpg[/img][/url][/td]

[/tr][/table]

There are also quite a few other interesting features! Starting from this update, you will be able to see your drivers, trucks and trailers on the manager map (a perennial item on the wish-list fulfilled, and it's not even Christmas yet!). We're also adding Chinese (and other non-Latin) character input, otherwise known as IME, which should make life easier for a part of our community.

Last but not least, we've improved Anti-aliasing and added avoidance navigational pins, the latter of which will allow you to set places you want to avoid on your GPS route.

[table][tr]
[td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/05e10e701ff93a576a61ed0c2a5ddb44eebd3224.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9084219/05e10e701ff93a576a61ed0c2a5ddb44eebd3224.jpg[/img][/url][/td]

notes.title: Pink Ribbon Charity Event Update
notes.notes:
We are only one week in with the World of Trucks Pink Ribbon Charity event and the community response has simply blown us away. So far we’ve reached over 730,000 deliveries of Pink Ribbon goods and there’s still 12 more days to go.

https://steamcommunity.com/games/227300/announcements/detail/1604895289728391993

Our #PinkMyTruck hashtag has been used for more than [url=https://twitter.com/search?q=%23PinkMyTruck&src=typed_query&f=live]2200 tweets[/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/explore/tags/pinkmytruck/]420 Instagram posts[/url], and hundreds of hours of the video has been uploaded to [url=https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=%23PinkMyTruck]YouTube[/url] and Twitch with hundreds of posts on Facebook. We’ve also seen some really cool Pink Ribbon Charity paint jobs made by the community of modders, and have been inspired by the impressive online multiplayer convoy events, organised by the online Virtual Trucking Companies, in support of the Pink Ribbon Charity event – you guys rock! And some of you even gifted the Pink Ribbon Charity Pack to fellow players! What a fantastic contribution and a good deed with a direct impact on both sides!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/3599071420a47cccdd73074aaff2a84523c2dc94.jpg[/img]

The event is far from over, yet we are already delighted and very proud to report that we’ve so far managed to secure more than $20,000 from the Pink Ribbon Charity Pack DLC sales and we will be sending out the first cheques to the designated Breast Cancer charities very soon.

We would like to take this opportunity to state again how much we support breast cancer awareness, research and patient support. We'd like to emphasize how important regular doctor visits and self-examinations are in fighting this terrible disease. By organising this event we have discovered many support groups around the world that all state the same message, which is to not be shy about checking yourself. Early diagnosis is the best defence.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/8ad84360b2b247e9bd53ba54e2b4b96828a2a8cc.gif[/img]

We're proud to be part of this campaign alongside many other advocates who're bringing awareness to this important cause - such as[url=https://twitter.com/NHSEngland/status/1179669957795368960] NHS England[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/MetLife/status/1179002952171819008]MetLife[/url],  [url=https://twitter.com/RenaultTrucksCo/status/1180437475854036992]Renault Trucks[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/mantruckbusuk/status/1181510373154926593]MAN Trucks & Bus[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/DAFTrucksNV/status/1179471207940407297]DAF Trucks[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/chevrolet/status/1179033366206783489]Chevrolet[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/MackTrucks/status/1179003281462513665]Mack Trucks[/url] and many others. And of course, a big thank you to every single person who have joined in and shared a screenshot or video under the #PinkMyTruck hashtag!

We hope you will join us tomorrow, Wednesday the 9th October, for our 2nd special charity stream which will be broadcast LIVE on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/scssoftware][b]Twitch[/b][/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/SCSsoftware][b]Steam[/b][/url] with SCS team members, [b]Alex[/b] (LondonLad), [b]Nemiro[/b], and [b]Pavel Sebor[/b] himself from 15:00 UTC (17:00 CEST). They'll be updating you on the progress, participating with jobs from the ongoing event, and handing out some more giveaways including Steam keys and one [b]Tobii Eye Tracker 4C[/b] device!

[url=https://eshop.scssoft.com/search-results?search_keyword=to+truckers+with+love&page=1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4419325/fff4fe987f09d4986f74a988179d86670a86448a.jpg[/img][/url]

Last but not least, if you weren't already aware of it, our [url=https://eshop.scssoft.com/]e-shop[/url] is also doing its part in the fight against breast cancer. [b]100% of any income from selling the "[url=https://eshop.scssoft.com/search-results?search_keyword=to+truckers+with+love&page=1]TO TRUCKERS WITH LOVE[/url]" T-shirts will also be donated to the selected Charities[/b], starting with the [url=https://www.bcrf.org/]Breast Cancer Research Foundation[/url] and the [url=https://www.breastcancer.cz/en/]Alliance of Women with Breast Cancer[/url]. We will be adding to that list soon!

notes.title: ATS Washington Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
We have loved sharing with you our progress on Washington, and with the final touches being made to the map, we are now ready to confirm a date...

[h1][b]We are excited to announce that the Washington map expansion for American Truck Simulator will be released on the 11th of June, 2019.[/b][/h1]

We hope that this short trailer will give you a small glimpse on what you will be able to experience for yourself very soon.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rfMXLvxqgoI
And as you can see for yourself, Washington will be rich in content for drivers to explore.
[list]
[*] 3,800 miles of dense road network
[*] 16 brand new cities (Vancouver, Longview, Aberdeen, Olympia, Tacoma, Seattle, Everett, Port Angeles, Bellingham, Omak, Wenatchee, Yakima, Kennewick, Grand Coulee, Spokane, Colville)
[*] More than 20 landmark bridges
[*] 10 original truckstops
[*] Keystone-Port Townsend Ferry
[*] Spokane swing bridge
[*] Grand Coulee dam
[*] Washington's iconic mountains (Mount St. Helens and Mt. Rainier)
[*] Challenging logging cliff road
[*] Dynamic speed limits and LED signs
[*] New unique cargoes: aircraft engines, piggy back trucks, boat...
[*] Large and realistic ports (Seattle, Tacoma, Everett)
[*] Many unique junctions
[*] Distinct company docks: yacht builders, vast farms, material storages...
[*] Washington-specific achievements to unlock
[/list]

With the upcoming release of this map expansion, you will see news, reviews, images, and videos appearing online this coming weekend. With a plan to lift the embargo, the media as well as trusted friends of SCS Software will be able to openly start showing their footage from the map.

Additionally, on Thursday the 6th and Saturday the 8th of June we will be hosting a special Washington stream (on both our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/scssoftware]Twitch[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/SCSsoftware]Steam[/url]) featuring gameplay of the new map expansion and special guests who were involved in the making of Washington. They will be guiding you through this new state, hosting giveaways, talking with you in the chats and much more, so make sure to tune in from 4pm UTC on Thursday and 5pm UTC on Saturday!

Related Washington posts: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/1712958942365784910]announcement[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/3476120204833251553]urban landmarks[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/1813167203026377862]prefab building[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/1815420464157583278]logging cliff road[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/1741112145203423256]farming[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/2603552833072291363]landscapes[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/1648790886583445844]Kenworth Renton assembly plant[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/1621771190468691879]Everett aerospace factory[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/2565275416680147543]Mount St. Helens[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/1622897728549571788]bridges[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/1613891161339511970]Seattle[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/1613891161350405834]Grand Coulee Dam[/url]

notes.title: ATS Update 1.35 Open Beta
notes.notes:
Since version 1.34 for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/]American Truck Simulator[/url] was more of a maintenance update, we understand how eager you all are for the 1.35 Open Beta - which is finally here!

[img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-5u_CCP1DUt0/XNQbEDvGHBI/AAAAAAAABkE/Y6VcAuOgaccyL5OLyPZsRZvcuBxrcwErACLcBGAs/s620/blog_ats_1_35_open_beta.jpg[/img]

Where to start? This update is yet again larger than any of its predecessors - and when we say "larger", we mean a LOT! There are changes in almost every part of our game, so let's get on it!

[table]
[tr]
[td][url=https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-l2-iEWc5ARs/XNQxu2TpbqI/AAAAAAAABlQ/gVQeeoy5he0oX5-1xk-uJR2sfUcLHd1ngCEwYBhgL/s0/r02.jpg][img]https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-l2-iEWc5ARs/XNQxu2TpbqI/AAAAAAAABlQ/gVQeeoy5he0oX5-1xk-uJR2sfUcLHd1ngCEwYBhgL/s300/r02.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url=https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-OEYopAnjqaE/XNQxvEFiqOI/AAAAAAAABlg/m8VA0tPhe00SlvzJzgRm7-pY_9FH_w2RgCEwYBhgL/s0/r03.jpg][img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-OEYopAnjqaE/XNQxvEFiqOI/AAAAAAAABlg/m8VA0tPhe00SlvzJzgRm7-pY_9FH_w2RgCEwYBhgL/s300/r03.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/]American Truck Simulator[/url] will receive two new roads, OR-58 and CA-299. OR-140 will also feature the final segment of its length. The Arizona sign system has also been improved along with Traffic lights (coming in later builds of the Open Beta) which have been re-worked for all current states.

[table]
[tr]
[td][url=https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-HXna1lnFm9A/XNQxwKHG_II/AAAAAAAABlk/tFGASJwmjgY1hVE9riOhi1UEEFRonU81gCEwYBhgL/s0/t2.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-HXna1lnFm9A/XNQxwKHG_II/AAAAAAAABlk/tFGASJwmjgY1hVE9riOhi1UEEFRonU81gCEwYBhgL/s300/t2.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url=https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-1UMxVWdKNLE/XNQxvkz7n-I/AAAAAAAABlY/0C8QBKpi9yoD-8j6lB6eEPHWzOlCorGwQCEwYBhgL/s0/t1.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-1UMxVWdKNLE/XNQxvkz7n-I/AAAAAAAABlY/0C8QBKpi9yoD-8j6lB6eEPHWzOlCorGwQCEwYBhgL/s300/t1.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td][url=https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-UGIiki1sU-k/XNQxwC5iX9I/AAAAAAAABlc/WRgS4w6p55girZ6jfITLAo4X0U1h94grQCEwYBhgL/s0/t3.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-UGIiki1sU-k/XNQxwC5iX9I/AAAAAAAABlc/WRgS4w6p55girZ6jfITLAo4X0U1h94grQCEwYBhgL/s300/t3.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url=https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-lk60xdE9Zg0/XNQxwRDbxEI/AAAAAAAABlg/4QAx9FE0Z3IDTSJO1ubnM2-udA-X83SzQCEwYBhgL/s0/t4.jpg][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-lk60xdE9Zg0/XNQxwRDbxEI/AAAAAAAABlg/4QAx9FE0Z3IDTSJO1ubnM2-udA-X83SzQCEwYBhgL/s300/t4.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

Besides the various new trailers listed in the change-log (B-doubles of all types, chip van trailers, container trailers, etc) and new cargoes, vehicles in our game also received some new features. This includes three windscreen wiper settings which will help drivers handle the improved rain, an accessory browser for owned trailers, expandable container trailers and a copy function for your truck and trailer configuration - which will come in handy, as your company continues to grow.

From the list of new general additions, some longtime wishes take first spots. One of those is a highly demanded option to use your own trailers for external contracts ([url=https://worldoftrucks.com/]World of Trucks[/url] jobs). From now on, you can!

DX11 experimental support. It's exactly as it sounds - most of the work on DX11 support is done, so the majority of its aspects are working quite well in our games and feedback from Experimental Beta promises a nice increase of FPS.  Still - it's not in its final state, so use it only at your own risk. Although we'll be grateful for your feedback.

[img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-YBm_wKpILwg/XNQxuM8pYhI/AAAAAAAABkc/L3GHSOeQufcwzjB3a_nZwbLij-bFu77_ACEwYBhgL/s620/drivers.jpg[/img]

Now comes a number of "smaller" additions, based mostly on your suggestions. A large amount of new hireable drivers have been added, so as your trucking empire grows you can expand much more than previously. To help with that growth, we've also added an option to purchase garages online (without the need of having to discover the city previously).

[table]
[tr]
[td][url=https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-pLftbrxu8lU/XNQxw5QlGkI/AAAAAAAABlo/VyYhun_BYewpyo2jmezGlzfSaT16GQ8iQCEwYBhgL/s0/ui.png][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-pLftbrxu8lU/XNQxw5QlGkI/AAAAAAAABlo/VyYhun_BYewpyo2jmezGlzfSaT16GQ8iQCEwYBhgL/s300/ui.png[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url=https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-qvPHZNxj6kM/XNQxubBqOLI/AAAAAAAABlk/u2dlA656bwcO29h5-F5KUSczmK1wFmrTgCEwYBhgL/s0/garage.png][img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-qvPHZNxj6kM/XNQxubBqOLI/AAAAAAAABlk/u2dlA656bwcO29h5-F5KUSczmK1wFmrTgCEwYBhgL/s300/garage.png[/img][/url][/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td][url=https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-R-Y1yRqhtjc/XNQxtXbfImI/AAAAAAAABlg/-54ziWAkTykfvmwbXafjy4nxLjcolG68ACEwYBhgL/s0/01.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-R-Y1yRqhtjc/XNQxtXbfImI/AAAAAAAABlg/-54ziWAkTykfvmwbXafjy4nxLjcolG68ACEwYBhgL/s300/01.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url=https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-zmLpgGNkfsM/XNQxtVDWCEI/AAAAAAAABlc/w0D9Se9eO6MR1tM8mzRkHCj3exOMgdoFwCEwYBhgL/s0/02.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-zmLpgGNkfsM/XNQxtVDWCEI/AAAAAAAABlc/w0D9Se9eO6MR1tM8mzRkHCj3exOMgdoFwCEwYBhgL/s300/02.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

Another helpful feature is emergency refuelling, which will be an important option for those loving to drive on the edge (why do so many of you like to go with empty tanks?). And to make your travels a little bit more diverse and interesting, you'll now see STAA doubles in traffic.

[table]
[tr]
[td][url=https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-lm3bFt72ro8/XNQxvTvgdPI/AAAAAAAABk0/ThnI9Ru6Ow8Jf5DTuxIs_TFkJYRf9Ob7gCEwYBhgL/s0/razer.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-lm3bFt72ro8/XNQxvTvgdPI/AAAAAAAABk0/ThnI9Ru6Ow8Jf5DTuxIs_TFkJYRf9Ob7gCEwYBhgL/s300/razer.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url=https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-7pZFHhfhLF8/XNQxtZXpJTI/AAAAAAAABkU/sqVWTDvENbIn-CYrnE7ueFcQUwuqXMLHACEwYBhgL/s0/Tracker4c_white_bg.jpg][img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-7pZFHhfhLF8/XNQxtZXpJTI/AAAAAAAABkU/sqVWTDvENbIn-CYrnE7ueFcQUwuqXMLHACEwYBhgL/s300/Tracker4c_white_bg.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

Considering all these changes, the UI had to change drastically. Players who helped us by entering the Experimental Beta have reported no serious issues with it, so we hope you'll have no problems as well. And to close the list, there're many new input improvements and official support for external peripheries.

[b]So enjoy all the new additions, but please remember: It's only an open beta, not a stable public version - so [u]you may encounter bugs, instability, kinks or crashes[/u]. It's completely okay if you want to wait for the final release. But if you're interested in helping us to move there faster, we'll appreciate all of your feedback on our [url=https://forum.scssoft.com/viewtopic.php?f=178&t=271053]forum[/url] and your bug reports in [url=https://forum.scssoft.com/viewforum.php?f=263]this section[/url].[/b]

[b]If you wish to participate in the open beta, you can find this version in the public_beta branch on Steam. The way to access it is as follows: Steam client → LIBRARY → right click on American Truck Simulator → Properties → Betas tab → public_beta → 1.35 public beta. No password required.[/b]

notes.title: New trailers in upcoming ATS update 1.35
notes.notes:
We are working hard on the new Update 1.35 for both [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/227300/Euro_Truck_Simulator_2/]Euro Truck Simulator 2[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/270880/American_Truck_Simulator/]American Truck Simulator[/url]. It's shaping up to be one of the biggest updates ever. We plan for an extensive open beta period, but there is still a lot of internal testing and tweaking left to do before we reach that stage. A series of upcoming blog posts will focus on key new features and new content.

In today's post, we want to focus on new types of trailers and loads coming to American Truck Simulator with Update 1.35. The new additions will be very handy in the Pacific Northwest!

Chip van trailers are coming to service the woodworking industry especially in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/800370/American_Truck_Simulator__Oregon/]Oregon[/url] and in our upcoming [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1015160/American_Truck_Simulator__Washington/]Washington state[/url] map expansion. They will be available with three body variants: van, moving floor, and iconic belly van. Chip van trailers are ownable and will be available to haul from the freight market.  We also plan to use them to transport other suitable loads in other industries and states.

[table]
[tr]
[td][url=https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-S55UDFRJC4s/XJj6ebA_JpI/AAAAAAAABck/oYvA0-ZmNUwEuCaL348Ym8AekmFUyM5HACEwYBhgL/s0/ats_hq_5c8b95ef_17.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-S55UDFRJC4s/XJj6ebA_JpI/AAAAAAAABck/oYvA0-ZmNUwEuCaL348Ym8AekmFUyM5HACEwYBhgL/s300/ats_hq_5c8b95ef_17.jpg[/img][/url][/td]

The new Kenworth truck manufacturing plant special prefab will produce plenty of trucks to deliver to truck dealers all around the game world. This new unique structure deserves its own topic in the near future, so we'll come back to it again.

notes.title: ATS update 1.33 is out!
notes.notes:
We are happy to release American Truck Simulator Update 1.33 out of open beta! Thanks to everyone who helped us verify the stability of the new features. We kept testing the ATS update a bit longer to make sure that there were no surprises with the new detours feature, and fortunately it looks like the reactions to it are all positive. We'll keep tweaking the feature in upcoming updates, and of course we owe it also to players of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/227300/Euro_Truck_Simulator_2/]Euro Truck Simulator 2[/url] - once we create the relevant new graphics content depicting the blocked roads.

[img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-ZdcyDVkBESw/XAqjHW0R9hI/AAAAAAAABQk/c5TW6LK1BskYiettorLI-nzkTrdTBKE5ACLcBGAs/s620/blog_ats_1_33_update.jpg[/img]

As both our flagship sims are running on the same codebase, American Truck's update benefited from the extended Experimental and Open Beta programs we have tried ahead of Euro Truck 2's new update. We are very likely to repeat the process again for most of the upcoming updates.

Even when we are not currently in open beta, we'd like to invite you to provide your feedback, input, wishes, and critique on our forums. We keep monitoring the message boards pretty much every day. The old school forums often work better for a discussion thread taking place across several days or weeks, compared to the typical quick fire and forget exchanges on newer generation social media.

Features are described in depth in the open beta announcement:
https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/1714079132251894910
Enjoy all the new additions and happy trucking. By the way, which changelog video do you like more?
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bcLccszlsA4

notes.title: ATS Update 1.33 Open Beta
notes.notes:
When there was no announcement of a Beta for American Truck Simulator, some of you were worried that Euro Truck Simulator 2 is getting all the love. It's true that ETS2 acutely needed an update to enable us to release [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/925580/Euro_Truck_Simulator_2__Beyond_the_Baltic_Sea/]Beyond the Baltic Sea[/url] map expansion, but there is more to ATS taking a bit longer out of the gate. Let's check the story below. We are proud to bring you American Truck Simulator Update 1.33 Open Beta, packed with new features!

[img]https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-Cbrb7e02u28/W_2ARaYKwlI/AAAAAAAABP0/N6JhdbJiIUgJgpniT-B9c2lgmxe1iKKnwCLcBGAs/s620/blog_ats_1_33_open_beta.jpg[/img]

As a counterpart to HCT trailers in Europe, ATS 1.33 brings you Turnpike double trailers (up to 100 ft). These trailers are pretty difficult to handle - in reality, they are in use only on specific roads built to meet their limitations. As of now, they are only allowed in Nevada in our game. You won't find jobs involving turnpike double trailers in freight market or quick jobs. The only way to use them is is to buy them (same as with HCT in Euro Truck 2) so that new players are not exposed to a challenge beyond their skill level.

[table]
[tr]
[td][url=https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-Pd2F_ihqac4/W_17V3fb9PI/AAAAAAAABPE/n8teVZUV4uwj7fSLivCKxxPbQcHNTpt2ACEwYBhgL/s0/ats_20181127_152852_00.jpg][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-Pd2F_ihqac4/W_17V3fb9PI/AAAAAAAABPE/n8teVZUV4uwj7fSLivCKxxPbQcHNTpt2ACEwYBhgL/s300/ats_20181127_152852_00.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url=https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-M6R1w6Bf56U/W_17V9_BLdI/AAAAAAAABPg/9PoJMkJMIOMGZ4kxLWZgk9VQMCUchSNBACEwYBhgL/s0/ats_20181126_161714_00.jpg][img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-M6R1w6Bf56U/W_17V9_BLdI/AAAAAAAABPg/9PoJMkJMIOMGZ4kxLWZgk9VQMCUchSNBACEwYBhgL/s300/ats_20181126_161714_00.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

There is one unique (and temporarily exclusive) new feature in ATS 1.33 - detours. We needed some time and focus to thoroughly review it internally before a public test, and this was the very reason why we avoided doing open betas for both games at the same time.

The goal of this feature is to introduce a bit of uncertainty into planning of your routes. The world in our games tends to be very predictable, while in reality the truck driver cannot take everything for granted. We wanted our players to have to improvise occasionally, and hence the concept of detours was born.

[url=https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-l3g0amr4ZBg/W_17Wl6rA5I/AAAAAAAABPg/zOEYbdy_NawD79XcALQgmAR8V88XsFlJgCEwYBhgL/s0/ats_hq_5bfd3921_21.jpg][img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-l3g0amr4ZBg/W_17Wl6rA5I/AAAAAAAABPg/zOEYbdy_NawD79XcALQgmAR8V88XsFlJgCEwYBhgL/s620/ats_hq_5bfd3921_21.jpg[/img][/url]

From time to time you'll find the road ahead of you blocked, maybe with state police waving you to go a different way, forcing you to remap your route. Or to search your memory for another option to reach your destination if you're so hardcore that you do not use the GPS. There'll always be a guaranteed way to deliver your cargo. But sometimes it can take more time than you'd be comfortable with, or move you away from the gas stations where you planned to refuel and get some rest. Detours are adding some adrenaline to the driver's job.

Think of this addition as "phase one" and please do give us your feedback. We hope that you will appreciate our ambition to spice up the universe of our games to make it feel more alive and dynamic.

[url=https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-hDo7q7QNzz4/W_17W819c8I/AAAAAAAABPo/0NUWGuyAvs4bVCo2sbqBxzDw_pJbcMQ4gCEwYBhgL/s0/ats_hq_5bfd40b3_16.jpg][img]https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-hDo7q7QNzz4/W_17W819c8I/AAAAAAAABPo/0NUWGuyAvs4bVCo2sbqBxzDw_pJbcMQ4gCEwYBhgL/s620/ats_hq_5bfd40b3_16.jpg[/img][/url]

For those of you hungry for new tarmac, we've added the first segment of OR-140. It remained on our wish-list for Oregon, and we are now catching up. We know how important this road is (trucking-wise) and its significance as "a shortcut", allowing you to avoid the long way around via US-20, or through California. The section we open today connects Lakeview and Klamath, a future extension we are also considering should reach to Nevada.

[url=https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-2zZkhPWegxg/W_17WksuzII/AAAAAAAABPc/dgZ6hMEdCkUYA0DOPiyovXq97TzgAmpEACEwYBhgL/s0/ats_hq_5bfc1bc7_10.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-2zZkhPWegxg/W_17WksuzII/AAAAAAAABPc/dgZ6hMEdCkUYA0DOPiyovXq97TzgAmpEACEwYBhgL/s620/ats_hq_5bfc1bc7_10.jpg[/img][/url]

The list of changes continues with the features that we have introduced in ETS2 1.33 already. You may have spotted them outlined in our [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=19V0Xgx64hY&t=5s&ab_channel=SCSSoftware]1.33 update video[/url].

Steam cloud-based profiles have received very positive reaction. Saving the game to a "cloud" can prevent potential loss of your profile due to a computer malfuction, or when changing your machine. It will also allow you to play on multiple computers without the need to carry a flash drive with you.

[table]
[tr]
[td][url=https://1.bp.blogspot.com/--MvvlL1c5Yk/W_17WRnRkvI/AAAAAAAABPk/0VtAdSHtQ7YvkQCYo-CTH4blnKC45dRVQCEwYBhgL/s0/ats_hq_5bfc1a92_09.jpg][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/--MvvlL1c5Yk/W_17WRnRkvI/AAAAAAAABPk/0VtAdSHtQ7YvkQCYo-CTH4blnKC45dRVQCEwYBhgL/s300/ats_hq_5bfc1a92_09.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[td][url=https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-Q9eB6PEExFw/W_17V7q26-I/AAAAAAAABPs/2eiClCwm4S8at9m-hz1E_SSooGa8d6zxACEwYBhgL/s0/ats_hq_5bfc1a2e_11.jpg][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-Q9eB6PEExFw/W_17V7q26-I/AAAAAAAABPs/2eiClCwm4S8at9m-hz1E_SSooGa8d6zxACEwYBhgL/s300/ats_hq_5bfc1a2e_11.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

Reusable truck and trailer configuration templates also received a pretty warm welcome, as the life of a big fleet manager became much easier. We have some ideas to take the feature even further in the future, but we believe it's going to be a great time-saver for many players in its current form already.

Minor changes include improved rain drop behavior on the windshield, music shuffling and localization for names of states (countries).

For people having issues with blinking lights, we've added a new cvar. Try different settings with writing g_disable_beacons 0/ 1/ 2 in the console. We hope that one of these will suit you well.

[b]So enjoy all the new additions, but please remember: It's only an open beta, not a stable public version - so you may encounter bugs, instability, and kinks. It's completely okay if you want to wait for the final release. But if you're interested in helping us to move there faster, we'll appreciate all of your feedback on our [url=https://forum.scssoft.com/viewtopic.php?f=178&t=264236]forum[/url] and your bug reports in this [url=https://forum.scssoft.com/viewforum.php?f=246]section[/url].[/b]

[b]If you wish to participate in the open beta, you can find this version in the public_beta branch on Steam. The way to access it is as follows: Steam client → LIBRARY → right click on American Truck Simulator → Properties → Betas tab → public_beta → 1.33 public beta. No password required.[/b]

notes.title: ATS Update 1.32 Open Beta
notes.notes:
The open beta of American Truck Simulator update 1.32 is available now, bringing most of the additions ETS2 received [url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/scs_games#announcements/detail/1716321419875422349]a week ago[/url] plus some ATS specific bonuses.

[u][b]IMPORTANT:[/b][/u] Due to the scope and scale of the major changes to the game, in order to receive as much feedback as possible, we're sharing this open beta with the community earlier than usual in the development cycle. There are still minor known issues that we're working on, and it’s possible there are even bigger bugs hidden away that we hope you’ll help us discover. If you think that the risk and possible frustration with an unstable and unpolished beta is worth it for you, make sure to backup your player profile to have a safe way to revert to 1.31 in case you get tired of testing. Many mods may have become broken due to extensive data format and logic changes. An early open beta gives the mod authors a chance to start making the necessary changes right away, but for testing at this moment, you may need to disable most mods just to get things working.

With the disclaimer out of the way, let's focus on different elements of this open beta.

[url=https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-2GNAavpOlYk/W3Q-GVyRFOI/AAAAAAAABDk/31F6sJucpyASqeqcJIhymCB54pwU-vpvQCLcBGAs/s0/blog_ats_1_32_open_beta.jpg][img]https://1.bp.blogspot.com/-2GNAavpOlYk/W3Q-GVyRFOI/AAAAAAAABDk/31F6sJucpyASqeqcJIhymCB54pwU-vpvQCLcBGAs/s620/blog_ats_1_32_open_beta.jpg[/img][/url]

Those reading the blog on a regular basis already know that the major addition coming in 1.32 is trailer ownership. So all the ATS players can now buy, tune and paint their trailers too. And since the laws and rules are a little bit different in the USA than in Europe, we added the option to use Long/Wide vehicles and Oversize Load banners to the trailer tuning options. Just don't forget to lock the trailers up if you want to use them only for yourself, since your employees might decide to try them out too!

[url=https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-lsZD6_fn_kQ/W3Q9tNIPDmI/AAAAAAAABDc/uJCiESKyFEItg5Tr3Rxv4HCJul9M0ke9wCEwYBhgL/s0/ats_20180815_155745_00.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-lsZD6_fn_kQ/W3Q9tNIPDmI/AAAAAAAABDc/uJCiESKyFEItg5Tr3Rxv4HCJul9M0ke9wCEwYBhgL/s620/ats_20180815_155745_00.jpg[/img][/url]

Same as in ETS2, some of the trailers were discarded and redesigned, while the rest was adjusted for trailer ownership.  This is just the first stage, as development is still ongoing – and will continue for at least a few more months of hard work. But we didn't want to keep you waiting for the final result when the actual state of trailer ownership allows us to let you play with these new toys already :)

[url=https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-lD3pJB8duME/W3Q9tMCKc3I/AAAAAAAABDc/PQZRdyEkoJM0Wkhx2X27roJmG3qBdtBjwCEwYBhgL/s0/ats_hq_5b73dd9e_07.jpg][img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-lD3pJB8duME/W3Q9tMCKc3I/AAAAAAAABDc/PQZRdyEkoJM0Wkhx2X27roJmG3qBdtBjwCEwYBhgL/s620/ats_hq_5b73dd9e_07.jpg[/img][/url]

With trailer ownership came the need to add "icons" to access the new functionality through the game's central "desktop" main menu, so we reorganized the user interface screen. You’ll probably notice that there are two larger widgets on the right side of the screen now, instead of three smaller ones. Also, new screens for trailer management have been added, and some company management screens had to be changed to handle the new feature.

[url=https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-JG4rSHGaMmo/W3Q9tjB6L0I/AAAAAAAABDU/ClrLl3ZL4-IObFmHmkTlmGrrBopIUx5fACEwYBhgL/s0/ats_hq_5b73efa1_08.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-JG4rSHGaMmo/W3Q9tjB6L0I/AAAAAAAABDU/ClrLl3ZL4-IObFmHmkTlmGrrBopIUx5fACEwYBhgL/s620/ats_hq_5b73efa1_08.jpg[/img][/url]

The next addition brings changes in the map. The ATS map design team felt that some gaps in the map deserved to be filled, while some other previous work should get a retouch. So in this update, ATS receives three new roads: US-550 – from Albuquerque to Bloomfield (Farmington), US-95 from Yuma to Quartsize (Ehrenberg) and US-191 which connects I-10 and US-60. Also, the intersection of I-5 and I-80 has been razed to the ground and built completely from scratch.

[url=https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-UZp5eSmFay4/W3Q9tMZfYlI/AAAAAAAABDc/BG-6EDxFIUcNAl7-0qGSV4f7x9keO5UMACEwYBhgL/s0/ats_hq_5b72e16d_08.jpg][img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-UZp5eSmFay4/W3Q9tMZfYlI/AAAAAAAABDc/BG-6EDxFIUcNAl7-0qGSV4f7x9keO5UMACEwYBhgL/s620/ats_hq_5b72e16d_08.jpg[/img][/url]

When driving on US-191, right by the newly added small city of Clifton, you'll discover Morenci Mine, the biggest copper mine in the United States. Surely a good place to visit, since there’s also a new cargo dock!

[url=https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-ArS-5iUf6Hg/W3Q9t-zLMEI/AAAAAAAABDY/kyVaOFyAXBAQAuMQ7b4Hc5d9P6v8nymIQCEwYBhgL/s0/ats_hq_5b740cba_08.jpg][img]https://4.bp.blogspot.com/-ArS-5iUf6Hg/W3Q9t-zLMEI/AAAAAAAABDY/kyVaOFyAXBAQAuMQ7b4Hc5d9P6v8nymIQCEwYBhgL/s620/ats_hq_5b740cba_08.jpg[/img][/url]

As for other changes, the new ATS update brings trailer cables on AI trucks and one new restriction – long trailers (53 feet – 40+ feet from kingpin to rear axle) are now forbidden in California. Plus one of the community's smaller wishes – parking brake is now disabled by default; those who liked this function need to turn it back on in game options.

Several changes to the code and data were made, related to rendering optimization, and it appears to have brought very nice framerate improvements in some scenarios. But since experience may vary, do share yours with us, please. We're really interested in your feedback on any noticeable FPS changes.

[url=https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-nw5v4W28Khk/W3Q9twFzomI/AAAAAAAABDc/6H4R_2FiUiEu83JuOGAr_WblRPsXGMuzACEwYBhgL/s0/ats_hq_5b73f592_07.jpg][img]https://2.bp.blogspot.com/-nw5v4W28Khk/W3Q9twFzomI/AAAAAAAABDc/6H4R_2FiUiEu83JuOGAr_WblRPsXGMuzACEwYBhgL/s620/ats_hq_5b73f592_07.jpg[/img][/url]

So enjoy all the new additions, but please remember: It's only an open beta, not a stable public version - so you may encounter bugs, instability, and kinks. This time more than ever, due to the sheer size of the update. It's completely okay if you want to wait for the final release. But if you're interested in helping us to move there faster, we'll appreciate all of your feedback on our [url=https://forum.scssoft.com/index.php]forum[/url] and your bug reports in [url=https://forum.scssoft.com/viewforum.php?f=236]this section[/url].

[b]If you wish to participate in the open beta, you can find this version in the public_beta branch on Steam. The method to access it is as follows: Steam client → LIBRARY → right click on American Truck Simulator → Properties → Betas tab → public_beta → 1.32 public beta. No password required.[/b]

[h1]CHANGELOG:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Trailer ownership
https://steamcommunity.com/games/americantrucksimulator/announcements/detail/1698306386977524431[/*]

[*]Remade and redesigned few places (e.g. I5-I80 interchange)[/*]
[*]Power/air lines on AI vehicles (optional)[/*][*]Rendering speedup[/*]
[*]Option for automatic parking brake - disabled by default[/*]
[*]Long 53ft trailers (40+ feet from kingpin to rear axle) forbidden in California[/*]
[/list]
